75ded4659c7cebd5da4f.title: Vendor Manager
75ded4659c7cebd5da4f.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Summary**

The Vendor Manager - Critical Environments is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and optimizing strategic relationships with third-party vendors and service providers. In conjunction with the Customer's Facilities Manager, the Vendor Manager serves as the primary point of contact for vendors, leading performance management, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role maintains regular communication to address issues, discuss and track performance (including Work Order completion), identify improvement opportunities, and verify and ensure accurate billing and invoice justification based on Corrigo and process payments. The key to success in this role is to be an open, transparent and consistent communicator to all stakeholders. In this role, you have the opportunity to shape a portion of the digital economy as well as the careers and lives of the teams supporting operations.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

Task will include but not be limited to:

* Lead weekly meetings with the client’s Operations teams to review vendor performance, address administrative and operational challenges, resolve outstanding issues, and drive accountability for corrective actions.
* Maintain consistent, proactive communication with the client’s Operations teams to identify emerging concerns, provide updates on vendor-related matters, and ensure alignment between vendor management initiatives and operational priorities.
* Establish, maintain, and optimize strategic relationships with third-party vendors and service providers supporting all data center systems including fire/life safety, mechanical, electrical, cabling, critical environments, and digital systems.
* Serve as primary point of contact for all vendors working within assigned facilities.
* Lead vendor performance management, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor vendor compliance with contractual obligations, service level agreements, and performance standards.
* Track and analyze vendor performance including Work Order completion rates, response times, and quality of service.
* Maintain regular communication with vendors to address issues, discuss performance, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Verify and ensure accurate billing and invoice justification based on Corrigo system data.

* Process vendor payments in accordance with contractual terms and approval workflows.
* Implement comprehensive warranty management program to track, enforce, and maximize the value of warranties on vendor-provided services and equipment.
* Establish and maintain centralized repository of all active warranties.
* Monitor warranty expiration dates and coordinate timely claims for covered repairs and replacements.
* Manage all aspects of vendor training to ensure familiarity with data center operations and critical systems.
* Provide advance training and notification to all contractors regarding the data center's critical functions and work requirements, including incident contact response lists.
* Ensure Data Center Work Rules are well-understood among all vendors and contractors.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding activities including system access setup, documentation collection, and stakeholder introductions.
* Maintain all vendor-related documentation including contracts, service agreements, insurance certificates, and compliance records.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory laws and guidelines as they relate to vendor operations within the data center's infrastructure.
* Prepare and report on vendor KPIs to track performance against established targets.

* Provide technical input and support to facility projects and modifications involving vendors, including construction support, commissioning, and final acceptance.
* Develop, review, and approve vendor work efforts including Mission Critical Statements for assigned facilities and systems.
* Identify vendor performance issues and implement corrective action plans.
* Conduct regular vendor business reviews to assess performance and alignment with facility objectives.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives with vendor partners and implement best practices.
* Alert management of vendor performance issues or building discrepancies requiring escalation.
* Perform additional job duties as requested.

Supervisory Responsibilities

* Directly supervise assigned personnel.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the policies enumerated with Jones Lang LaSalle and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees.
* Planning, assigning, and directing work.
* Appraising performance.
* Rewarding and disciplining employees.
* Addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Minimum Requirements:**

Education & Experience

* Hands-on experience working in a data center/critical facility, including UPS.
* Systems, emergency generators, and switchgears.
* High School diploma or GED equivalent
* Seven to ten years of engineering experience or equivalent industry experience
* Five to seven years supervisory experience.
* Moderate knowledge of a variety of manual trades such as carpentry, electromechanical repair, etc.

Language Skills

* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, or governmental regulations and codes.
* Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
* Ability to speak effectively before small groups of tenants or fellow employees.
* Demonstrated verbal/written communication skills.

Other Skill and Abilities

* Ability to use drawings, specifications, shop math and various measuring or testing instruments.
* Working knowledge or the capability of developing proficient knowledge of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Microsoft Access and any other software packages.
* Must be able to professionally interact with tenants and contractors.
* Demonstration of leadership ability, presentation capabilities and organization skills.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Corrigo Experience.
* MCIM / Salesforce Experience.
* Zendesk Experience.
* Service Now Experience.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position will require the following:

* Walking large, campus-like settings.
* Frequent walking, climbing, bending, kneeling, lifting, stooping, and working/extending overhead, including:
* Lifting a minimum of 50 lbs.
* Climbing stairs and navigating rooftops to access equipment.

**Customer Environment Description**

* A leading global data center developer and operator specializing in delivering state-of-the-art digital infrastructure solutions across the globe. With more than 50 high-performance mission-critical facilities worldwide, the company ensures the continued operation of digital infrastructure for nearly 800 customers, including approximately 200 Fortune 1000 companies.
* Demanding customer and fast-paced environment, serving some of the largest companies in the world.
* JLL operates 40 sites for the customer that includes campuses and individual data centers. We provide sourcing and vendor management support including a full sourcing team, Vendor Managers, and Vendor Coordinators.
* JLL has been supporting the customer since 2021. The relationship has continued to grow as the customer’s business has grown; we continue to support current locations and assist in establishing new sites across the United States.
* Our goal is to continue a fruitful relationship that allows us to grow with the customer. This will provide many opportunities for our employees and allow our customer to scale their business.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

**Expected compensation for this position:**

  
120,000.00 – 140,000.00 USD per year

*Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.*

**Location:**

Remote –Allen, TX

**Job Tags:**

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

**Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:**

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits include:

* 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care
* Paid parental leave at 100% of salary
* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
* Early access to earned wages through Daily Pay

At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.

This email is only to request an accommodation. Please direct any other general recruiting inquiries to our Contact Us page > I want to work for JLL.

3f6a2802d7c185658204.title: Senior Industrial Architect
3f6a2802d7c185658204.description:
**Overview**
------------

We are seeking a **Senior Industrial Architect** to join our team in ***Exton, PA****.*

This position is expected to work in the office a minimum of three days per week, with project travel as required. The successful candidate will be a highly experienced industrial architect with extensive expertise in the planning, design, and delivery of cleanroom and controlled-environment facilities. This individual will serve as a technical leader, trusted advisor, and project architect responsible for developing innovative facility solutions that meet operational, regulatory, quality, and safety requirements while supporting client business objectives.

This position is intended for a Senior Principal/Subject Matter Expert/Technical Director-level professional with demonstrated leadership in cleanroom and advanced manufacturing facility design.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead architectural design, planning, and execution of large-scale industrial and manufacturing facilities.
* Develop facility concepts, programming, master plans, feasibility studies, and basis-of-design documentation.
* Provide architectural leadership for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities; biotechnology and laboratory environments; semiconductor fabrication facilities (fabs); food and beverage processing plants; cleanrooms and controlled environments (ISO 5-8/Class 100-100,000); and industrial warehouse and production facilities.
* Coordinate closely with process engineering, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, automation, validation, and construction teams.
* Lead development of GMP-compliant architectural solutions for regulated facilities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, industry standards, and client requirements.
* Participate in client presentations, design reviews, and stakeholder workshops.
* Develop architectural standards and design guidelines for cleanroom environments.
* Conduct constructability reviews and support execution planning.
* Mentor junior architects and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Support business development efforts, proposals, technical interviews, and client relationship management.
* Provide technical oversight during procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, and startup activities.
* Review and approve architectural deliverables, including conceptual designs, floor plans, equipment layouts, cleanroom classifications, material and personnel flow diagrams, BIM models, and construction documents.

**About you**
-------------

* Bachelor'S or Master's degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.
* Registered Architect (RA) required.
* Minimum 20 years of architectural design experience for industrial and manufacturing facilities.
* Minimum 10 years of direct cleanroom facility design experience.
* Proven experience delivering multiple projects in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage production, and industrial production facilities.
* Extensive knowledge of GMP and cGMP facility requirements; ISO 14644 Cleanroom Standards; IBC, NFPA, and local building codes; FDA-regulated facility design; and environmental, health and safety (EH&S) requirements for industrial facilities.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams.
* Strong knowledge of architectural detailing for cleanrooms, controlled environments, and critical process spaces.
* Proficiency with Revit, BIM 360, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office applications.

*Technical expertise:*

* Cleanroom envelope design; material and personnel flow segregation; airlock and gowning design; contamination control strategies.
* Clean utility integration; process area adjacency planning; hazardous material classifications; architectural systems for controlled environments.
* Facility master planning; modular and prefabricated cleanroom systems; industrial fire and life safety design; operational readiness and facility startup support.

*Leadership competencies:*

* Strategic thinking and problem solving.
* Client relationship management and executive-level communication skills.
* Technical leadership, mentoring, and staff development.
* Design quality management and project delivery excellence.
* Business development and proposal support.

*Preferred qualifications:*

* Experience with major EPCM, engineering consulting, or design-build organizations.
* Experience on projects exceeding $100 million in capital value.
* Knowledge of Annex 1 requirements for pharmaceutical manufacturing, BSL laboratory facilities, semiconductor wafer fabrication facilities, aseptic processing facilities, and advanced therapy medicinal product (ATMP) facilities.
* LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP) certification.
* Experience supporting global clients and international projects.
* Experience with digital project delivery and BIM execution planning.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

At AtkinsRéalis, our values—Safety, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, and Excellence—are more than just words. They are the foundation of who we are and how we work. These principles shape our culture, guide our decisions, and inspire us to create an environment where every team member feels empowered to grow, succeed, and make a meaningful impact.

Depending on your employment status, AtkinsRéalis benefits may include medical, dental, vision, company-paid life and short- and long-term disability benefits, employer-matched 401(k) with 100% vesting, employee stock purchase plan, Paid Time Off, leaves of absences options, flexible work options, recognition and employee satisfaction programs, employee assistance program, and voluntary benefits.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

**Additional information**
--------------------------

Expected compensation range is between $150,700- $188,400 annually depending on skills and experience.

**Are you ready to expand your career with us? Apply today and help us shape something extraordinary.**

**AtkinsRéalis is an equal opportunity, Drug-Free employer EOE/Veteran/Disability**

AtkinsRéalis cares about your privacy and is committed to protecting your privacy. Please consult our Privacy Notice on our Careers site to know more about how we collect, use and transfer your Personal Data. By submitting your personal information to AtkinsRéalis, you confirm that you have read and accept our Privacy Notice.

**Note to staffing and direct hire agencies:**

In the event a recruiter or agency who is not on our preferred supplier list submits a resume/candidate to anyone in the company, AtkinsRéalis family of companies, we explicitly reserve the right to recruit and hire the candidate(s) at our discretion and without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. https://careers.atkinsrealis.com/recruitment-agencies

2829b3d4cc84b27da20d.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager, Axon 911
2829b3d4cc84b27da20d.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**About Axon 911**  
  
Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.  
  
911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

#### **Your Impact**

As a **Senior** **Technical Project Manager**, you'll lead the successful delivery of mission-critical cloud and IT deployments that power emergency communications for public safety agencies across the country. You'll oversee projects from kickoff through go-live, ensuring implementations are delivered on time while coordinating technical and operational resources across Axon 911, our partners, and our customers. Serving as the primary technical liaison, you'll work closely with engineering, product, implementation teams, and public safety stakeholders to scope technical requirements, drive cloud deployments and system integrations, and ensure seamless cutovers into production. This role requires balancing technical expertise with exceptional project leadership, building trusted relationships with customers, and delivering solutions that directly support first responders and the communities they serve when every second matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end deployment of cloud-based platforms, including system configuration, testing, and go-live support
* Collaborate with customers, partners, and internal teams to implement scalable, secure, and resilient IT solutions tailored for public safety
* Create/manage project and technical implementation plans (e.g., infrastructure readiness, data flows, failover testing)
* Coordinate with DevOps, R&D, and Solution Architects to align product capabilities with deployment requirements
* Manage expectations across stakeholders, resolve issues proactively, and ensure milestone delivery
* Facilitate system handovers to customer IT teams and lead onboarding/training where required
* Identify post-deployment support needs and optimization opportunities for add-on services

#### **What You Bring**

* PMP or CAPM certified
* Have 5+ years of experience managing global technical projects, preferably within a B2B SaaS, IT, or cloud services company
* Are experienced in leading cross-functional teams through cloud or hybrid infrastructure implementations
* Possess strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, and cloud deployment models (AWS, Azure, etc.)
* Have a proven ability to translate customer needs into actionable technical plans
* Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced startup culture and are confident interfacing with both technical and executive stakeholders
* Are open to domestic travel to support project execution and client success (up to 20% or more)

Nice-to-Haves:

* Experience with ESInet and NG911 i3-compliant technologies
* Familiarity with systems used by PSAPs or other emergency services
* Hands-on experience managing projects involving cloud-native architectures or real-time communication platforms
* Demonstrated ability using AI tools, cross-platform integrations, and innovative tools

#### **Work Location**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates who currently reside in the United States.

#### **Benefits that Benefit You**

* Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all
* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Fitness Programs
* Emotional & Mental Wellness support
* Learning & Development programs
* And yes, we have snacks in our offices

*Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.*  
  
**Pay Transparency**  
  
**Axon is a total compensation company**, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The starting base pay for this role is between $100,050.00 in the lowest geographic market and $176,000.00 in the highest geographic market. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors.
  
  
Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially, and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings, please visit www.axon.com/careers/benefits.

  

Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Important Notes**

*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*

*Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.*

*We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.*

*Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.*

*We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.*

Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

**Job description:**

Pay: $78,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Job description:

Clinical Supervisor - Home Health (RN)

Allentown, PA

$78,000 - $80,000 + Bonus | Full-Time | Leadership Opportunity

*Lead from the Office. Impact the Field. Shape Patient Care.*

At 365 Health Services, great patient care starts with strong clinical leadership. As a Clinical Supervisor, you’ll work alongside our Client Service Managers and operations team in our Allentown office - coordinating care across the full continuum and serving as the clinical backbone of our field nursing team.

This is a role for a Registered Nurse who is ready to bring their clinical expertise to a broader stage - influencing patient outcomes, supporting nurses in the field, and building relationships with the providers, insurers, and care teams that surround each patient.

Applicants will need to be actively working as an RN for at least 1 year - if you’re a strong RN ready to grow into leadership, we want to hear from you!

**Why 365?**

* ACHC Accredited agency with a strong reputation for quality care
* Collaborative in-office environment alongside operations and clinical teams
* Meaningful leadership role with real impact on patients and nurses alike
* Opportunities for career growth in a rapidly expanding organization
* Flexible, hybrid-friendly culture - we value your time and trust your judgment
* Diverse patient population: pediatric and adult
* 24/7 operational and clinical on-call support
* A team built on communication, compassion, and clinical excellence

**Position Overview**

As a Clinical Supervisor, you’ll be primarily office-based, working in close collaboration with Client Service Managers and operational staff to coordinate care between our internal team and external partners - including insurance providers, primary care physicians, hospitals, and care coordinators.

You’ll build and manage care plans based on physician orders, conduct patient assessments at least every two months, and join sales visits with managers to meet new patients entering skilled services. You’ll also play an active role in the training and development of our field nursing staff alongside our education department.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate care for assigned pediatric and adult patients from admission to discharge, including comprehensive ongoing assessments at minimum every 60 days
* Collaborate daily with Client Service Managers and operations staff to ensure seamless internal care coordination
* Communicate and coordinate with external providers including insurance companies, primary care physicians, hospitals, and care coordinators
* Develop and manage individualized care plans based on physician orders
* Conduct sales visits alongside managers to newly referred patients entering skilled nursing services
* Supervise, support, and educate field nursing staff - ensuring they feel connected, competent, and backed by the office team
* Partner with the education department on onboarding, training, and ongoing clinical education for field nurses
* Perform on-site supervisory visits to assess patients, families, environments, and clinical caregivers with complete follow-up documentation
* Evaluate quality of nursing practice and identify opportunities to improve patient outcomes and field performance
* Ensure all nursing practice aligns with physician orders, agency policy, and state regulations
* Serve as a patient and family advocate throughout the care journey

**Qualifications**

* Active PA or Compact Registered Nurse (RN) License - REQUIRED
* Diploma, Associate, or Bachelor’s degree in Nursing from a state-accredited RN program - REQUIRED
* Valid driver’s license and acceptable MVR - REQUIRED
* Minimum one year of nursing experience - REQUIRED
* Previous pediatric or home health experience - preferred
* Previous case management experience - preferred
* Supervisory or leadership experience - preferred, but not required

**Skills & Abilities**

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills - comfortable working across internal teams and external stakeholders
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage a varied caseload
* Effective problem-solver with sound clinical judgment
* Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure
* Comfortable working with diverse pediatric and adult patient populations
* Knowledge of compliance, regulatory standards, and professional nursing practice
* Commitment to clinical excellence and patient-centered care
* Must read, write, speak, and understand English
* Must maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries at all times

**Work Setting**

This is a primarily in-office role based out of our Allentown, PA location, with flexibility built in. You’ll spend the majority of your time working alongside our clinical and operations team, with periodic field visits for patient assessments and supervisory visits.

* Office-based in Allentown, PA
* Periodic home visits and on-site supervisory assessments
* Occasional sales visits to prospective patients with skilled services
* May include exposure to varied environments, allergens, bodily fluids, or infectious diseases during field visits

**Benefits**

* $78,000 - $80,000 base salary + performance bonus
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Paid training and onboarding
* Leadership development and career growth opportunities
* Supportive, team-oriented work environment

**Join a Team That Values You**

At 365 Health Services, we’ve built something special - a company founded in 2014 by people with over 25 combined years of industry experience, driven by two core beliefs: keeping patients safe and healthy at home, and giving caregivers meaningful, rewarding work.

We’re growing fast, and we’re growing the right way - through strong relationships, great communication, and a relentless commitment to quality. If you’re a Registered Nurse ready to lead, collaborate, and make a lasting impact, apply today and see what sets 365 apart.

*Please note: This job description is not designed to cover all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties may change at any time with or without notice.*

Work Location: In person

03b8c49a5c29e53aa87a.title: Senior Insider Threat Investigator
03b8c49a5c29e53aa87a.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

The Senior Insider Threat Investigator develops and executes portions of the enterprise insider threat investigation and analytics program for assigned areas. The role supports complex investigations, analytics-driven risk assessments, and mitigation activities related to insider risks, including data loss, fraud, misuse of systems, and policy violations.  
  
This position requires senior-level subject matter expertise, applying advanced analytical, technical, and risk judgment skills to evaluate highly complex user behavior, support investigative decision-making, and communicate outcomes to investigative, legal, compliance, cybersecurity, and business leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develops and expands insider threat investigation knowledge and capability; communicates complex investigative methodologies, findings, and mitigation strategies to investigators, partners, and less‑experienced team members.
* Performs portions of high‑complexity insider threat investigations by analyzing user activity, access patterns, logs, behavioral data, and investigative artifacts to develop timelines, risk assessments, root‑cause analyses, and evidentiary documentation.
* Coordinates required investigative actions and communications in alignment with insider threat response plans and guidance from leadership to mitigate risk, protect sensitive information, and ensure timely, defensible outcomes.
* Supports research and analysis of potential and known insider threat risks, trends, and control gaps across assigned areas; evaluates effectiveness of investigative and monitoring controls and documents results.
* Develops and enhances portions of investigative playbooks, workflows, and response procedures; monitors indicators of insider risk and supports detection, escalation, and containment activities.
* Partners with Cybersecurity, IT, Legal, Compliance, HR, Privacy, and Analytics teams to ensure investigative activities are compliant with regulatory, legal, privacy, and internal control requirements.
* Translates investigative findings and operational needs into recommendations for process, service, and technical improvements to strengthen the insider threat program and overall risk posture.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**
-------------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in insider threat programs, cybersecurity investigations, digital forensics, or risk analytics.
* Advanced knowledge of insider threat investigation methodologies, behavioral monitoring, and forensic analysis techniques.
* Experience with DFIR, SIEM, and investigative analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of regulatory and control frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR).
* Ability to apply data‑driven insights to risk mitigation and program improvement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive‑level reporting.

The firm is seeking an Associate Portfolio Manager who is a key member of the wealth management team supporting portfolio management, client reporting, trade processes, and problem resolution. This is a remote position.

The successful Associate Portfolio Manager candidate will work closely with the lead Wealth Advisor and Portfolio Manager to ensure integrity of the investment process and ability to articulate technical, or problem solving information clearly to the team. This position requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, positive professional attitude, and ability to work in a fast paced team environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

The Associate Portfolio Manager can expect to focus their work in the following areas:

* Maintain portfolio accounting and investment trading systems, interface with all areas of the firm
* Strong knowledge of portfolio administration such as fund transfers and withdrawals, tax strategies, capital gains, and losses, calculation of stepped-up cost basis
* Perform research, including writing research reports on holdings under management
* Communicate market events and portfolio strategies
* Handle cash management on a daily basis
* Create and verify client performance reports
* Perform daily and weekly electronic reconciliation of systems to custodial records
* Knowledge of equity compensation a plus
* Ability to demonstrate specific examples of experience with UHNW clients and investment operations background
* Strong collaborative work ethic, problem solving and proactive approach, ability to demonstrate methods of efficiency and provide recommendations for workflow systems improvement to contribute in a fast-paced performance-driven environment
* Ability to demonstrate achievements and contributions to scaling business
* Polished communication skills and ability to interact professionally with clients and office personnel. This includes both written and verbal communication
* Ability to work independently
* Experience with the Schwab custodial platform, Orion, Wealthbox is preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Office; Excel, Word, Powerpoint, Google docs
* Strong technology skills in Video Chat, Google docs, and CRM preferred

**Associate Portfolio Manager Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
* Series 65 License
* CFA preferred but not required
* DFA experience preferred
* A friendly professional demeanor and ability to excel in a team oriented environment

**Required Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree

**Job Type and Benefits**

* Remote
* Full-time

* Health Insurance

Advisor Business Solutions provides staffing, strategic marketing and training services for financial services, government, and corporations nationwide. Our 20+ year industry background offers the expertise and resources to deliver exceptional results and experiences to our clients.

e043a0db5dbae3a117db.title: Project Coordinator
e043a0db5dbae3a117db.description:
Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

The **Project Coordinator** supports Project Managers and cross‑functional teams in the successful delivery of software initiatives. This role is responsible for **project organization, tracking, documentation, and communication**, ensuring that work stays aligned to scope, schedule, and process.

In a fast‑paced software environment, the Project Coordinator plays a critical role in keeping projects running smoothly by maintaining project artifacts, monitoring risks and issues, coordinating meetings, and ensuring accurate, timely information flows between internal teams and customers.

This role is ideal for someone early in their project management career who is highly organized, detail‑oriented, and eager to grow within a technology‑driven organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project Coordination & Tracking**

* Maintain and update project schedules, task lists, and milestones in project management tools
* Track and update RAID logs (Risks, Actions, Issues, Decisions)
* Monitor progress against plan **and flag risks, dependencies, and delays to the Project Manager**
* Support tracking of change requests, scope updates, and project decisions

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up‑to‑date project documentation and artifacts in designated repositories
* Prepare weekly project status reports and dashboards for internal and customer stakeholders
* **Capture meeting notes, action items, and decisions; follow up to ensure closure**
* **Ensure project records follow established standards and frameworks**

**Meeting & Communication Support**

* Coordinate and support internal and external project meetings
* **Prepare agendas, materials, and presentations for project forums**
* **Distribute meeting minutes and action items** **in a timely manner**
* Serve as a communication bridge between Project Managers, delivery teams, and stakeholders

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Track team time, allocations, and PTO as needed for project planning
* Support budget tracking and basic financial reporting
* Monitor tickets, defects, and issues in systems such as Jira or ServiceNow
* Assist with SharePoint or project site setup and ongoing maintenance

**Process & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure projects adhere to defined delivery methodologies and governance standards
* Identify opportunities to improve project coordination, reporting, and execution efficiency
* Support audits, readiness reviews, and operational checkpoints as required

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, or a related role
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a deadline‑driven environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort working with cross‑functional teams in a software or technology setting

**Preferred**

* Experience in a SaaS, software, or professional services organization
* Familiarity with project and collaboration tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Salesforce, SharePoint, or similar
* Exposure to Agile or hybrid delivery environments
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* CAPM from PMI or equivalent certification

**Key Competencies**

* Organization and follow‑through
* Stakeholder communication
* Risk and issue awareness
* Tool proficiency and data accuracy
* Professional judgment and discretion
* Continuous improvement mindset

**Career Growth**

This role provides a strong foundation for progression into:

* Associate Project Manager
* Project Manager
* Program or Delivery Operations roles
* The Project Coordinator gains hands‑on exposure to real project delivery, customer interaction, and enterprise software operations.

**Geographic Responsibility:** Remote, US

**Type of Employment:** Full-time, permanent

**FLSA Classification (USA Only):Non-Exempt**

**Work Environment:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

* The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
* May require travel dependent on company needs.

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is recruiting a **Release / Deployment Coordinator** for our proposed support to the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Information and Technology, Compensation and Pension (C&P) Product Line Help Desk Tier 2 and Deployment Support Services 2.0. **This position is contingent upon contract award.** Remote work from anywhere in the United States.

**ABOUT THE WORK**

The Release / Deployment Coordinator plans and documents production releases for a VA product line on a two-week Agile release cycle and coordinates weekend and Sunday deployments across VA operations teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Prepare the Release Management Plan, Deployment Plan (3-5 days before release) and Post-Validation Deployment Report for each release
* Coordinate with VBA Enterprise Operations, Benefits Gateway System, Benefits Enterprise Platform, Office of Business Integration and infrastructure teams; attend daily and weekly calls
* Produce the Weekend Deployment Graphic, Hour-by-Hour (HBH) schedule in MS Project, HBH coordination notes, Integration Environments one-sheet and patch calendar one-sheet
* Coordinate end-user validation testing with VBA user representatives, including Sunday deployment support

* 5+ years in software release, deployment or change coordination in an Agile environment
* Advanced MS Project, PowerPoint and Excel; Jira and SharePoint
* Available for scheduled weekend and Sunday deployment windows
* Bachelor's degree, or 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree

* ITIL 4 Foundation

Remote within the United States; Sunday deployment support; face-to-face meetings if within 50 miles of the VA site.

This role provides inside sales support for the Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NWPT) service line, assists the Vice President of Business Development with administrative and organizational responsibilities, and coordinates sales performance tracking and KPI reporting. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, proactive communication, attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and effective collaboration with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other internal teams to support business development objectives.

* Coordinate with Territory Sales Managers and Operations to support customer onboarding, implementation of new business, and successful service delivery.

* Provide administrative support to the VP of Business Development, including scheduling, meeting coordination, preparation of presentation, and follow-up on key initiatives.

* Compile, track, and maintain business development KPIs, including sales activity, pipeline development, revenue trends, customer retention, and other key performance indicators.

* Monitor sales activity and reporting trends, identifying discrepancies, outstanding action items, and opportunities for process improvement.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and administrative tools and platforms (e.g., Monday.com, Power Point, Microsoft, CRM experience is a must.

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines

* Experience supporting or managing trade shows and events

* Data-driven mindset for tracking KPIs and optimizing marketing performance

a6ba9c5c47976851880d.title: Director RCM - Billing Operations and Integrations
a6ba9c5c47976851880d.description:
PRIMARY FUNCTION
  
The Director of Revenue Cycle Management – Billing Operations & Integrations is responsible for leading enterprise-wide billing operations, claim generation, claim quality, edit resolution, clean claim production, acquisition integrations, and revenue cycle operational readiness across the organization. Reporting to the Senior Vice President (SVP) of Revenue Cycle Management, this position provides strategic and operational oversight of centralized billing functions, ensuring claims are submitted accurately, timely, and in compliance with payer requirements while supporting organizational growth through acquisitions, practice onboarding, and technology integrations.
  
  
This leader serves as the operational owner of acquisition diligence performance, acquisition integrations and pre-bill revenue cycle performance and is responsible for developing standardized workflows, implementing enterprise billing best practices, and driving automation initiatives that improve claim quality, reduce rework, and accelerate reimbursement. Is responsible for onboarding acquisitions, implementing systems, designing, applying and managing effective billing operations. The Director partners closely with Revenue Integrity, Coding, Patient Access, Information Technology, Managed Care, Finance, and Operational Revenue Cycle leaders to optimize workflows, support system conversions, and establish scalable processes across a centralized business office (CBO) environment.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
This list may not include all the duties that may be assigned.
  

* Lead all enterprise billing operations supporting professional and ambulatory services.
* Oversee pre-bill claim review processes to ensure accurate claim generation and submission.
* Establish enterprise billing standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
* Monitor claim submission performance and billing productivity across all markets and specialties.
* Ensure compliance with payer billing requirements and organizational policies.
* Serve as Revenue Cycle operational lead for acquisitions, mergers, practice onboarding, and integration initiatives.
* Develop and execute revenue cycle integration plans for newly acquired practices and provider groups.
* Coordinate system readiness, workflow design, payer enrollment support, and billing operational transitions.
* Partner with Information Technology, EHR, PM system, and implementation teams to support system upgrades, migrations, and conversions.
* Ensure successful transition of billing operations into enterprise standard workflows.
* Develop post-integration monitoring processes to identify and resolve operational gaps.
* Develop, maintain, and implement enterprise-wide billing and claim management standard operating procedures.
* Partner with other RCM Directors in establishing governance and operational controls supporting centralized business office operations.
* Ensure policies remain current with regulatory, payer, and operational requirements.
* Develop and oversee enterprise billing quality assurance programs.
* Establish quality review methodologies for claim accuracy, edit resolution, and billing compliance.
* Monitor performance through routine audits and quality assessments.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and staff education.
* Track and report quality performance trends
* Oversee governance and maintenance of billing-related PM system files.
* Collaborate with Information Technology, Coding & RCM teams to ensure accuracy of:
* Payer master files
* Provider records
* Location records
* Billing rules
* Edit configurations
* Claim routing tables
* Implement change management controls to maintain data integrity and operational stability.
* Oversee enterprise claim edit management strategies.
* Develop automated workflows that reduce manual intervention and improve claim quality.
* Analyze billing edits to identify root causes and opportunities for process improvement.
* Partner with Revenue Integrity, Coding, and Patient Access teams to reduce recurring edit volumes.
* Implement automation tools to improve first-pass claim acceptance rates.
* Lead enterprise clearinghouse management and optimization initiatives.
* Ensure efficient claim transmission and monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with vendors and IT teams to implement automation capabilities.
* Reduce manual claim handling and improve electronic claim acceptance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, artificial intelligence, robotic process automation (RPA), and workflow technologies.
* Monitor clearinghouse performance metrics and service-level expectations.
* Monitor rejection trends and implement corrective action plans.
* Coordinate resolution efforts across operational, technical, and clinical teams.
* Minimize claim delays through proactive issue identification and resolution.
* Ensure claims are submitted within organizational and payer-established timeliness requirements.
* Monitor claim lag and billing turnaround times.
* Develop workflows that prioritize rapid resolution of front-end claim issues.
* Ensure root-cause analysis is performed on recurring rejection patterns.
* Manages and gives directions to support training staff when needed during on-site implementation of new processes, technology, systems, and integration.
* Oversees day-to-day change management activities and regularly analyzes measurable performance and KPI’s to ensure positive financial outcomes for the acquired practice(s).
* Reports acquisition’s practice performance to senior management.
* Collaborates with departmental heads to develop financial plans and ensure companywide compliance.
* Evaluates organizational efficiency and makes necessary changes to maximize staff productivity.
* Assists with special projects and reports to ensure maximum payments.
* Other various duties as assigned, including cross training in other functional areas.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Manages a team of RCM positions including but not limited to Revenue Operations Manager, Billing Analyst, Billing Assistant, Reimbursement Specialist / Lead, RCM System Administrator, eCW Billing System Administrator. Includes evaluating and completing annual evaluations, hiring, and training.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
**EDUCATION:**  

* Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* Master’s Degree preferred.

LICENSURE
  

* None

**EXPERIENCE:**  

* Minimum 8–10 years of progressive healthcare revenue cycle leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years leading RCM operations and M&A Activities
* Experience within physician practice management, ambulatory healthcare, MSO, or health system environments.
* Demonstrated success improving RCM performance, denial recovery, and reimbursement outcomes.
* Experience building and managing centralized business office (CBO) operations preferred.
* Skilled at defining problems, collection of data, interpreting billing information.
* Strong leadership and communication skills both written and verbal.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  

* Experienced leadership and expertise in direct management of business operations.
* Knowledge of and experience in developing workflow plans with subsequent training, implementation, and performance analysis as it relates to corporate goals.
* Excellent communicator and team leader influencing peers and employees effectively in order to achieve stated goals.
* Communicate clearly and concisely.
* Performance driven and accountable to establish team and individual goals, monitor and report to senior management.
* The ability to represent the Company both internally and externally in order to forward organizational goals and initiatives.
* Skilled with interpreting business analytics as well as developing regular reporting for staff, peers, and senior management.
* Computer literate in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

TYPICAL WORKING CONDITIONS
  

* Non-patient facing
* May be full time remote/telework.
* Must be U.S. based.
* Office environment:
* Travel will be required between PA locations and acquisition locations.
* Involves high & frequent call volumes.
* Multi-tasking, data entry for extended period of times

OTHER PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  

* Vision
* Sense of sound
* Sense of touch
* Operate computer
* Manual dexterity; sitting
* Ability to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

fe83e02e868861e6f4b4.title: Epic OpTime and Anesthesia - Business Systems Analyst - Senior / Intermediate
fe83e02e868861e6f4b4.description:
**How to Apply**
----------------

A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should address your specific interest in the position and outline skills and experience that directly relate to this position.

**Division Overview**

The HITS Clinical & Revenue Cycle IT (CRC) division is responsible for more than 350 clinical and revenue cycle applications that clinicians, staff, and patients rely upon daily. The CRC team has subdivisions that support inpatient, surgical, anesthesia, ambulatory, departmental, and revenue cycle areas across Michigan Medicine. CRC also oversees many of the major IT platforms and applications such as the electronic health record, virtual care, pharmacy, radiology, radiation oncology, registration, document management, billing, and much more.

  

The CRC team is highly relied upon across the healthcare system and collaborates with operational partners to provide excellent service to the Michigan Medicine staff. Team members within CRC interact with customers on a regular basis by implementing and configuring workflows, enhancements, optimizations, and new modules or software while also ensuring adequate change control and testing processes occur. Team members work on a vast array of projects that propel Michigan Medicine into the future. The HITS MiChart OpTime Anesthesia team at Michigan Medicine is seeking a candidate to fulfill the role of Business Systems Analyst Sr.

**Job Summary**
---------------

HITS seeks a Business Analyst to support the anesthesia/operating rooms/surgical services, interventional procedure rooms, diagnostic vascular unit, cardiac cath and EP labs. Primary responsibilities include supporting and maintaining the Epic OpTime and Anesthesia, as well as third party software used by anesthesia, operating and procedure rooms. The Application Coordinator is the primary support contact for the applications. As an Anesthesia/OpTime analyst, this person works with clients to translate surgical related workflows to Epic functionality, identify gaps, and provide mutually agreeable solutions to close workflow gaps. Provides support to clinical users by adapting software to meet their needs through knowledge processes, documentation needs, workflows, and practice standards.

**Responsibilities\***
----------------------

The Business System Analyst is responsible for the following tasks:

* Responsible for coordination and performance of analysis, design development, testing validation and implementation of EMR modules used by clinicians performing and documenting patient care activities, leveraging system functionality to support clinical process and organizational goals.
* OpTime Anesthesia analysts coordinate issues that arise for their application areas and must be knowledgeable about the organization's policies, procedures, quality standards, and business operations.
* This position requires familiarity with pre-procedure, intra-procedure, post-procedure, and out of OR workflows, regulatory requirements, Hospital & Professional billing, and patient experiences as well as understanding a wide array of integration points.
* Epic Certification or proficiency in Optime or Anesthesia. Familiarity with Clarity, Caboodle or other data/reporting systems is advantageous.
* Work with U-M business community/clinical staff to ensure the system meets the organization's needs.
* Perform in-depth analysis of workflows, data collection, report details, and other technical issues associated with Epic software.
* Understand the choices involved in application specifications and present them to end users in a meaningful way.
  + Investigate end users' preference while making build decisions.
  + Analyze business operations as they relate to build decisions.
  + Under general supervision formulates and defines system scope and objectives through research and fact-finding to develop or modify complex information systems.
* Continue to maintain and enhance Epic software.
  + Prioritize and implement requested changes to the system.
  + Analyze new functionality in releases to determine how it should be used.
  + Coordinate, review and test new release.
  + Maintain regular communication with Epic representatives.
* Participate in training and work with end users.
  + Troubleshoot problems and questions from end users.
  + Provides ongoing support of the EMR system and the end-users.

Work with report writers to ensure that the application has the necessary reports.

**Required Qualifications\***
-----------------------------

**Senior Level**

* BA/BS degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 5+ years of IT related experience
* Demonstrated ability to perform business/workflow analysis, document business requirements, create scope documents, and standardize operating procedures
* Ability to facilitate the investigation and resolution of development and project issues in a self-directed and timely manner
* Solid and effective written, verbal, and interpersonal skills
* Working knowledge of communication/collaboration tools, including spreadsheets, presentation, and word processing software
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, understanding of LEAN principals
* Ability to work as part of a team to support multiple clinical and administrative user groups
Share in rotating on-call responsibility, including evenings and weekends  

**Intermediate Level**

* BA/BS degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 2-3 years of IT related experience
* Demonstrated ability to perform business/workflow analysis, document business requirements, create scope documents, and standardize operating procedures
* Ability to facilitate the investigation and resolution of development and project issues in a self-directed and timely manner
* Solid and effective written, verbal, and interpersonal skills
* Working knowledge of communication/collaboration tools, including spreadsheets, presentation, and word processing software
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, understanding of LEAN principals
* Ability to work as part of a team to support multiple clinical and administrative user groups
* Share in rotating on call responsibility, including evenings and weekends

**Desired Qualifications\***
----------------------------

* 5-7 years of relevant experience in healthcare industry
* Experience and certification in any Epic applications, particularly: OpTime, Anesthesia, and Cupid
* Perioperative Services/Anesthesia/Operating Rooms/Surgical Services/Procedure Rooms/Cardiology clinical experience
* Project management experience

**Modes of Work**
-----------------

Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes.

**Work Locations**
------------------

This position is being made available with the ability for you to negotiate alternative work schedules and remote/on-site options to suit your work-life balance.

Non-Michigan residents should inquire about potential employment while working remotely in a state other than Michigan. Apply to be part of a strong team that partners with our institution, community, and each other.

**Underfill Statement**
-----------------------

This position may be underfilled at a lower classification depending on the qualifications of the selected candidate.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Benefits**

We offer a benefits package that includes comprehensive training and career development opportunities, generous retirement savings plans, ample paid time off, and a wealth of family care support: https://careers.umich.edu/benefits.

**Background Screening**
------------------------

Michigan Medicine conducts background screening and pre-employment drug testing on job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent job offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background screenings. Background screenings are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Report Act. Pre-employment drug testing applies to all selected candidates, including new or additional faculty and staff appointments, as well as transfers from other U-M campuses.

**Application Deadline**
------------------------

Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended.

**U-M EEO Statement**
---------------------

The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

**Description**

  
  

ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION ASSOCIATE PROJECT MANAGER

This position is based in our office in multiple locations.

About ArchKey

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.  
  
We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset, bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

About the Position

As an Associate Project Manager, you will assist the Project Manager in the overall administrative and technical direction for one large complex project or direct smaller size projects under the supervision of a Project Manager. Assistant Project Managers may have overall bottom-line responsibility for profit and loss, and consequently carry the authority appropriately, and will provide technical and engineering support as required by the project assigned.

Day in the Life

  

* Assist in the total construction and design effort (if applicable) to ensure project is constructed in accordance with design, budget, and schedule.
* Act as a liaison to coordinate communication between both internal and external members on the project. Including, but not limited to, General Contractors, Subcontractors, Superintendents, and Foremen.
* Assist the Project Manager in the authorization and/or approval of all project staffing including, but not limited to, choice of superintendent, general foremen, and foremen.
* Perform specialized estimating and assists in estimating projects.
* Assist the Project Manager with purchase requisitions, payment approvals, and change order requests.
* Assists in the implementation/interpretation of safety programs and ensures that all OSHA requirements are met.

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* Minimum 0-1 year of construction and/or project experience OR knowledge of construction methods.
* Project Managed training, experience or skills with a general understanding of a project lifecycle.
* Strong process orientation, analytical and mathematical skills.
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Outstanding interpersonal and team leadership skills.
* Must possess strong attention to detail and ensure maximum quality of work throughout the lifecycle of the project.
* Must be willing to travel to and potentially temporarily relocate to project locations.
* Experience with Accubid a plus.
* Experience with Bluebeam Revu a plus.

  
**Salary Range**  

* $65,000 -$104,000 annually, based on location, experience and qualifications.

Benefits

At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com.

Legal & Fraud Disclaimer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We are an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer. *#MN70-6*

Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. To confirm the legitimacy of a job, visit our careers page or reach out to a member of our Talent Acquisition team. #MO1-10

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The CareDx Regional Director (RD) is responsible for driving growth, building strong client relationships, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional results in their assign geography. Focusing primarily on transplant center account customers, the RD will lead, manage and partner with a diverse team of regionally aligned roles, including Transplant Account Managers (TAMs), Clinical Liaisons (CL) and Medical Science Liaisons (MSL) from the Medical Affairs team. Successful RDs are agile, proven problem solvers with strategic account management expertise and strong communication skills, possessing the ability to provide clear direction and hold the regional team accountable to execution and results. The RD role reports directly to the Sr Area Director.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Account Management:** Develop a deep understanding of account's needs, objectives, and challenges in order to provide tailored solutions that meet their requirements. Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts to upsell and cross-sell relevant CareDx products, solutions or services.

**Strategic Planning and Executing Account Plans:** Develop and execute strategic plans to drive business growth and achieve sales targets. Create and implement long-term, account-specific strategies and tactics to drive adoption, gain market share, expand the CareDx footprint and achieve commercial goals.

**Building Strong Customer Relationships:** Identify key customer stakeholders and influencers, establishing strong relationships and partnerships, continually soliciting feedback on additional needs, products, and features. Resolve customer issues promptly and efficiently, managing expectations and ensuring customer satisfaction.

**Managing the Sales Pipeline:** Forecast and manage the sales pipeline and growth strategies to track progress towards objectives at both the account and regional levels. Prepare regular performance reports for executive leadership, providing insights into strategy effectiveness, ROI, and key other performance indicators

**Lead, Manage, and Coach**: Lead, manage, and coach a field team consisting of TAMs and DSS to achieve business objectives and deliver exceptional customer service.

**Team Development:** Foster a positive and collaborative team environment, providing ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance team performance.

**Performance Management:** Monitor and evaluate team performance, providing regular feedback and implementing improvement plans as necessary.

**Collaborating with Internal Teams**: Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Customer Experience, Medical Affairs, Market Access and Operations teams to develop creative solutions that address customer needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required, advance degree (e.g., MBA) preferred
* Minimum of 10 years sales or strategic account management experience in the healthcare industry
* Minimum 5 years sales management experience in the healthcare industry
* Experience selling into hospitals, hospital/health systems, and/or enterprise-level accounts, navigating across multiple levels of stakeholders and departments
* Experience with complex, multi-touch, long sales processes/cycles (6-9months) and closing deals
* Track record of developing effective commercial strategies that maximize business outcomes
* Demonstrated, proven track record developing high performing teams and building collaborative relationships within the organization and with external customers
* Strong written and oral communication & organizational skills
* Must be willing to travel 50- 75% or greater, including frequent day trips and overnight travel
* Proficient with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Salesforce.com and analytical tools

**Role Competencies:**

* **Healthcare Market Understanding:** Anticipates the potential business implications of an evolving healthcare marketplace and identifies new opportunities for growth
* **Business & Territory Planning:** Aligns market and customer needs and insights with CareDx products, solutions and services to develop strategic action plans
* **Analytics and Insight Generation:** Leverages many sources of complex business and customer data to generate insights, identify market trends and opportunities, and inform decision making.
* **Account Management:** Develops a deep understanding of customer needs and aligns them with CareDx products, solutions and services to attain mutually beneficial outcomes
* **Consultative Selling Agility:** Applies selling skills to understand and meet customer needs and ensure sales execution is compliant and strategically aligned with business objectives to maximize sales results
* **Leading Through Influence:** Builds alignment and mobilizes cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority to advance strategic priorities, overcome barriers, and achieve shared business and customer outcomes.

**Additional Details:**

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes:

* Competitive base salary and incentive compensation
* Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program
* 401(k) savings plan match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* And more!
* Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers

In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.

With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it's an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.
