### **What you will do**

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen is seeking a **Senior Director, Content and Audience Strategy** to define and lead enterprise content and audience strategy across commercial and stakeholder engagement channels. This leader will translate complex business needs and transformation initiatives into scalable, personalized, and governance-compliant content solutions.

The Senior Director will build and lead a high-performing content and audience strategy function, bringing together content strategy, audience analytics, production, taxonomy, metadata, governance, and stakeholder management. The role will partner with business and portfolio leads, digital product managers, and transformation stakeholders to turn business use cases into audience-driven content strategies and coordinated, multi-channel roadmaps.

This leader will establish the standards, operating models, and governance frameworks needed to connect audience needs with content production capabilities, channel requirements, brand messaging, regulatory expectations, and measurable business outcomes. The role will also oversee content production strategy and external partner relationships, while guiding the integration and adoption of taxonomy, metadata, content management, and audience intelligence capabilities across the enterprise.

The Senior Director will represent content and audience strategy in executive forums and transformation governance, creating clear decision materials, surfacing dependencies and risks, and helping teams sustain momentum through complex, multi-year change.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Content and Audience Strategy**

* Lead a high-performing content and audience strategy function with strong capabilities in content strategy, audience analytics, and stakeholder management.
* Structure, hire, develop, and performance-manage the content and audience strategy team.
* Partner with business leads, portfolio leads, digital product managers, and transformation stakeholders to translate business use cases into audience-driven content strategies and multi-channel content roadmaps.
* Develop an integrated content architecture that connects audience needs, production and channel capabilities, brand messaging, regulatory requirements, and measurable business outcomes.
* Assess content operational maturity, production complexity, technology readiness, governance requirements, and transformation dependencies for content-driven initiatives.
* Set enterprise standards for audience segmentation, content strategy, and content governance.

**Content Production Leadership and Oversight**

* Define production strategies and roadmaps aligned with content priorities and audience engagement plans.
* Establish reusable content standards, governance frameworks, and quality assurance processes that support brand consistency, regulatory compliance, and efficient medical and legal review.
* Partner with creative, marketing operations, medical, legal, compliance, privacy, brand, and digital teams to ensure content is brand-aligned, compliant, and production-ready.
* Oversee channel-specific content production requirements and templates for HCP, patient, customer, and internal stakeholder audiences.
* Manage relationships with external creative agencies, translation services, production vendors, and platform partners; establish service levels, quality standards, and cost benchmarks.

**Taxonomy and Metadata Leadership and Oversight**

* Define the strategic direction for enterprise taxonomy frameworks that classify content, audiences, channels, and business domains in alignment with commercial strategy and transformation initiatives.
* Provide guidance on metadata standards and governance requirements, and oversee their implementation and maintenance across content systems.
* Guide the integration of taxonomy and metadata into content management systems, customer data platforms, and marketing automation tools, working with technology partners as needed.
* Monitor taxonomy and metadata quality through regular reviews and reporting, identify improvement opportunities, and hold the team accountable for continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop the taxonomy and metadata management team, ensuring it has the skills, tools, authority, and support to maintain enterprise standards and respond to evolving business needs.

**Transformation Adoption and Governance**

* Drive enterprise adoption of content platforms, content management systems, taxonomy and metadata standards, and audience intelligence tools by communicating their value and setting clear expectations.
* Own and maintain the portfolio transformation roadmap, including dependencies, milestones, risks, and budget tracking.
* Represent content and audience strategy in governance forums with business leads, portfolio leads, digital product managers, and transformation stakeholders; surface decisions, escalate blockers, and document progress.
* Manage cross-pillar interdependencies and help teams anticipate upcoming needs and risks.
* Build and execute communication strategies that support enablement across groups, including role clarity, onboarding, and workflow integration.
* Coordinate with key partners to support delivery accountability and value realization.
* Track and report on planned milestones, and maintain the future-state strategic vision, milestones, workforce strategy inputs, and investment projections.

**Executive Communication**

* Represent content strategy in executive forums, portfolio reviews, and transformation governance discussions.
* Guide the transformation narrative to sustain organizational momentum and leadership confidence.
* Create executive-ready decision materials that clearly communicate strategic options and business impact.
* Lead stakeholder readiness planning across business, technology, and measurement groups to support adoption of new ways of working.

**Win**
-------

### **What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The leader we seek is an experienced, audience-centric strategist who can connect content, data, technology, and business transformation. They bring the judgment to set enterprise direction, the ability to build and develop strong teams, and the influence to align senior stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Doctorate degree and 5 years of experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, or enterprise program management; OR
* Master’s degree and 8 years of experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, or enterprise program management; OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, or enterprise program management; OR
* Associate’s degree and 14 years of experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, or enterprise program management; OR
* High school diploma / GED and 16 years of experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, or enterprise program management.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 12 or more years of progressive experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, or enterprise program management, including at least five years at the Senior Director level or above.
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformations within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Deep experience in organizational adoption for technology-driven transformations, including executive communications and stakeholder readiness.

* Strong command of data strategy, taxonomy, metadata governance, and enterprise data management principles.

* Deep understanding of content management systems, customer data platforms, audience segmentation, and marketing automation platforms.
* Experience enabling offshore or nearshore capability centers in India or similar global enterprise settings.

cdcdddeeb3cd4724b075.title: Sr Clinical Trials Data and Technology Analyst
cdcdddeeb3cd4724b075.description:
* Job ID: JR-115462
* Entity: Remote
* Location Name: Remote-Rhode Island
* City, State: Providence, RI
* Work Type: FULL TIME
* Hours Per Week: 40
* Shift: Day
* Posted Date: 10/23/2026

**The Senior Clinical Trials Data and Technology Analyst**
----------------------------------------------------------

The Senior Clinical Trials Data and Technology Analyst serves as a senior technical resource for the clinical research applications, data integrations, analytics, and reporting solutions managed by the Center for Clinical Research Management (CCRM). Working under the direction of the Manager of Clinical Trials Data and Technology, the Senior Analyst independently performs complex application administration, data management, reporting, validation, technical development, and system enhancement activities supporting Brown University Health’s clinical trial operations.

The Senior Analyst provides advanced technical support for OnCore, eReg, REDCap, TrialConnX, Advarra Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Snowflake, and associated integrations with Epic, Workday, and other institutional systems. The position leads assigned technical projects, develops and maintains data pipelines and reporting solutions, troubleshoots complex application and data issues, and recommends workflow and system improvements.

Within the technology strategy, application governance, and priorities established by CCRM leadership, the Senior Analyst works closely with the Brown Health Office of Cancer Research (BHOCR), clinical research departments, Information Services, and external vendors to implement and support reliable, compliant, and efficient clinical research technology solutions. Serves as the primary technical resource for CCRM-supported clinical research applications and research informatics solutions.

Given BHOCR’s significant operational experience with and historical investment in OnCore, the Senior Analyst facilitates ongoing technical collaboration between CCRM and BHOCR. This includes gathering oncology-specific requirements, evaluating workflow impacts, supporting testing, and helping develop solutions that address both institutional and oncology research needs while remaining consistent with CCRM’s governance of the enterprise OnCore platform.

In addition to our values, all employees are expected to demonstrate the core Success Factors which tell us how we work together and how we get things done. The core Success Factors include:

* Instill Trust and Value Differences
* Patient and Community Focus and Collaborate

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of **Compassion**, **Accountability**, **Respect**, and **Excellence** as these guide our everyday actions with patients, customers, and one another.

**Clinical Research Systems Administration**
--------------------------------------------

* Independently administers, configures, supports, and optimizes clinical research applications, including OnCore, eReg, REDCap, TrialConnX, Advarra Analytics, and related systems.
* Serves as a senior technical subject matter expert for research applications, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Evaluates system issues, recommends solutions, and implements approved enhancements in accordance with established governance and change-control processes.
* Develops and maintains application documentation, technical specifications, and user support materials.
* Provides advanced end-user training and technical support.
* Manages clinical research technology training curricula within NetLearning, including assignment, maintenance, updates, completion tracking, and coordination of training requirements for system access and onboarding.
* Evaluates training effectiveness and recommends enhancements to support user adoption, data quality, and compliance with institutional standards.

**Data Management, Reporting, and Analytics**
---------------------------------------------

* Designs, develops, and maintains operational, regulatory, financial, and executive reporting solutions.
* Develops dashboards, data visualizations, metrics, and key performance indicators using approved analytics platforms.
* Performs advanced data analysis and develops reporting solutions that support operational decision-making and organizational goals.
* Supports the development and maintenance of research data marts, data models, and reporting environments.

**Data Integration and Technical Development**
----------------------------------------------

* Develops, maintains, and supports data pipelines, system integrations, APIs, and automated workflows.
* Participates in system implementations, upgrades, migrations, interface testing, and technical enhancement projects.
* Develops programs, scripts, and data transformation processes to support reporting, analytics, and data quality initiatives.
* Identifies and resolves data integrity, integration, and workflow issues.

**Compliance, Validation, and Quality Assurance**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serves as the technical lead for 21 CFR Part 11 validation activities associated with eReg and other regulated clinical research systems, including the development, execution, and maintenance of validation plans, test scripts, requirements traceability documentation, change-control records, and associated validation deliverables.
* Leads assigned validation activities for regulated research systems, including development and maintenance of test scripts, validation documentation, and change-control records.
* Ensures application changes are appropriately documented, tested, and implemented in accordance with institutional policies and regulatory requirements.
* Supports ongoing data quality, compliance, and system integrity initiatives.

**Collaboration and Project Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Leads assigned technology, reporting, and workflow improvement projects.
* Collaborates with CCRM, BHOCR, Information Services, research departments, and external vendors to support clinical research technology initiatives.
* Supports the evaluation, testing, and implementation of application enhancements and workflow improvements.
* Provides technical guidance and mentorship to analysts, coordinators, and research personnel.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**BASIC KNOWLEDGE**
-------------------

* Advanced knowledge of clinical trial management systems, research applications, analytics, reporting platforms, and research informatics.
* Demonstrated expertise in application administration, data integration, reporting, business intelligence, and workflow optimization within a clinical research environment.
* Strong understanding of clinical trial operations, data governance, system validation, regulatory requirements, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance principles.
* Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex technical and operational issues, develop practical solutions, manage multiple priorities, and provide technical guidance to users and team members.
* Proficiency with clinical research applications and analytics tools, including OnCore, eReg, REDCap, TrialConnX, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Snowflake, APIs, SQL, Python, and related technologies preferred.

**EXPERIENCE**
--------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Health Informatics, Data Analytics, Clinical Research, or a related field required.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of progressively responsible experience in research technology, application administration, data management, analytics, reporting, or research informatics within a healthcare, academic, or research environment.
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise applications, developing reporting and analytics solutions, managing data integrations, and leading complex technical initiatives.
* Experience with clinical trial management systems, validated applications, and regulated research environments preferred.
* Clinical research experience, including experience as a clinical research coordinator, nurse, regulatory specialist, research data manager, or other research operations role, is preferred.
* Experience translating clinical, operational, and regulatory requirements into technology solutions supporting clinical research workflows is highly desirable.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**
----------------------------------------------

* Normal office environment with frequent computer use and regular interaction with clinical research, operational, and technical personnel.
* Occasional travel between Brown University Health locations may be required to support system implementations, training, or project activities.

**INDEPENDENT ACTION**
----------------------

Exercises a high degree of independent judgment in the administration, configuration, support, and optimization of clinical research applications, reporting platforms, and data integrations.

Independently evaluates technical issues, develops solutions, leads assigned projects, and recommends system and workflow improvements.

Works within established CCRM governance, policies, priorities, and technology standards while collaborating with BHOCR and other key stakeholders to support clinical research technology initiatives. Refers matters involving strategic direction, institutional priorities, governance decisions, significant resource allocation, competing stakeholder priorities, or major system changes to the Manager of Clinical Trials Data and Technology.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY**
------------------------------

Provides technical leadership, mentoring, training, and work direction to analysts, coordinators, and other research personnel involved in clinical research technology and reporting activities.

May lead project teams and coordinate assigned technical initiatives. Does not have direct responsibility for hiring, performance management, compensation, or disciplinary actions.

bea35fb82c96ec775495.description:
Description:

**Remote: Florida**

**Job Purpose & Overview** The Program & Services Intake Coordinator serves as the central point of coordination for program and service inquiries, referrals, and intake activities. This part-time, remote position manages a centralized intake process that helps autistic individuals, families, caregivers, guardians, referral sources, and community partners access clear, accessible, and timely information about available programs and services. The Intake Coordinator gathers and documents intake information, supports the enrollment processes, maintains intake records and tracking systems, and supports cross-departmental communication. Working closely with the program team, this role helps ensure inquiries and referrals are accurately documented, routed, tracked, and followed through, supporting timely access to programs and a consistent intake experience across the organization.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Intake Coordination**

* Serve as the main point of contact for people seeking information or support from Els for Autism programs and services.
* Gather required information and guide each intake request from first contact through a clear handoff to the appropriate program team.
* Document intake activities accurately, track next steps, and follow up in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with program teams so information is shared clearly and people understand what to expect next.
* Use respectful, person-centered communication that is clear, flexible, and responsive to different communication and support needs.
* Protect confidential information and follow organizational privacy requirements.
* Complete other related duties that support organizational operations and the mission of Els for Autism

**Individual & Caregiver Intake Support**

* + Collect required intake information and documents using CentralReach or other designated systems.
* Help individuals and families understand requirements, timelines, missing information, and next steps.
* Keep records organized and provide program teams with complete, accurate information for review or enrollment.

**Program & Service Coordination**

* Maintain current knowledge of Els for Autism programs, availability, eligibility guidelines, and enrollment steps.
* Gather and document intake information, including program interest, support needs, and eligibility requirements, to support appropriate referral intake view, and enrollment processes
* Coordinate with program teams and confirm handoffs so intake information and next steps are clear.

**Data Management & Systems Administration**

* Maintain complete, accurate, and timely intake records in designated systems.
* Prepare reports on inquiry volume, response times, enrollment, and service needs.
* Monitor inquiry, referral, and intake trends to help to identify service needs, improve intake processes, and support program planning across the organization.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

* This is a remote position that requires reliable internet access and a workspace suitable for confidential work.
* The role involves regular computer use and communication by phone, video, and email, as well as managing multiple priorities.
* Confidential information must be handled in accordance with organizational policies.
* Reasonable accommodations may be provided to support qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

Requirements:

**Required**

* At least two years of relevant experience in a nonprofit, healthcare, education, human services, disability services, or community-based organization involving intake coordination, enrollment operations, program administration, case management, or a related function, with knowledge of autism services, community resources, and intake, referral, or enrollment processes.
* Fluency in English and Spanish, including the ability to communicate professionally in both spoken and written formats.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple inquiries, priorities, deadlines, and follow-up activities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively and accessibly with individuals who have diverse communication styles, support needs, and accessibility preferences.
* Commitment to providing respectful, responsive, person-centered support to autistic individuals, families, caregivers, guardians, providers, and community partners.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience using EMRs, CRM systems, databases, project management platforms, or similar record-management systems.
* Ability to learn and adapt to new technology platforms, systems, and organizational processes.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with diverse stakeholders while exercising sound judgment when gathering information, routing inquiries, and determining appropriate next steps.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associates degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Human Services, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered
* Experience supporting autistic individuals, individuals with disabilities, caregivers, families, or support networks in healthcare, education, human services, or community-based settings.
* Experience generating reports, tracking data, and using information to identify trends, support decision-making, and improve service delivery.
* Experience coordinating intake, referrals, enrollment activities, or cross-program support processes across multiple programs, departments, or stakeholders.

**Additional Requirements**

* Level 2 Background Clearance
* Complete Els for Autism Foundation required staff training
* Must be available to work within Els for Autism operational hours and organizational needs, including occasional mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, camps, community events, and other organizational activities.
* Must adhere to ethical standards and maintain confidentiality requirements, including HIPAA compliance.

**Rate of Pay:** $24.00 - $27.00 per hour

8fcfcba5c8eb7595889d.title: Opening & Operations Producer (Freelance / Contract)
8fcfcba5c8eb7595889d.description:
**Location:** Philadelphia, PA (Hybrid: On-site & Remote)

**Engagement:** Initial 30-day contract, with potential extension

**Start:** ASAP

**Compensation:** To be discussed based on experience and scope

**About the Opportunity**

We're preparing to open a new, independently developed cultural experience in Philadelphia and are looking for an experienced, resourceful, hands-on **Opening & Operations Producer** to help bring it across the finish line.

The creative vision is established, the project is well underway, and many of the major pieces are already in motion. Now we need someone who can take ownership of the remaining production, procurement, vendor coordination, and operational details and **make things happen.**

This is not a creative direction, strategy, or consulting role. We're looking for someone who knows how to get complex projects open and operational, who can comfortably juggle multiple moving parts, make sound independent decisions, and solve problems without needing constant direction.

**What You'll Own**

* **Retail & Merchandising:** Coordinate merchandise assortment, source suppliers, negotiate pricing, calculate margins, manage purchasing, establish inventory and reorder systems, populate the POS catalog, and oversee stocking and merchandising.
* **Food & Beverage:** Source and coordinate vendors for a curated tea, chocolate, and beverage offering. Negotiate pricing and quantities, place orders, coordinate deliveries, and establish practical service procedures.
* **Signage & Fabrication:** Manage vendors for exterior, interior, and wayfinding signage, including production, fabrication, permitting, electrical coordination where needed, and final installation.
* **Casting & Talent Coordination:** Coordinate casting logistics for media production, confirm performers and roles, manage availability and scheduling, and negotiate compensation within approved budgets.
* **Production & Vendor Management:** Coordinate remaining contractors, fabricators, suppliers, deliveries, purchases, and physical installations. Keep vendors accountable, resolve issues, and ensure work is completed on schedule.
* **Pre-Opening Operations:** Help coordinate staffing, onboarding, training, operational supplies, facility needs, guest-service procedures, and other practical requirements for opening.
* **Testing & Opening Readiness:** Identify operational gaps, coordinate testing and adjustments, troubleshoot issues, and ensure the venue, systems, supplies, and staff are ready to welcome guests.
* **Cross-Team Coordination:** Work alongside existing creative, technical, sales, marketing, and publicity resources to keep production and operational milestones aligned with the overall launch schedule.
* **Day-to-Day Project Ownership:** Independently manage priorities, deadlines, vendors, and outstanding tasks. Bring founders consolidated decisions requiring creative or budgetary approval rather than a constant stream of questions.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Proven experience **personally managing the execution** of complex openings, experiential productions, cultural attractions, hospitality venues, exhibitions, or similarly multifaceted projects.
* Strong practical experience with vendor sourcing, purchasing, negotiation, production logistics, budgets, and operational coordination.
* Familiarity with retail operations, inventory management, POS systems, merchandising, and/or hospitality service setups.
* A demonstrated ability to manage several overlapping workstreams, anticipate problems, and make good decisions independently.
* Strong organizational skills, resourcefulness, persistence, and exceptional follow-through.
* Philadelphia-based, with an understanding of the local market and an established network of vendors, fabricators, contractors, and other resources.
* Experience with museums, libraries, themed entertainment, immersive experiences, cultural institutions, arts organizations, or hospitality is a major plus.
* Comfortable working in a creative, entrepreneurial, non-corporate environment.

**The Most Important Part**

**We're looking for someone who can take work off our plates, not create more of it.**

We're a small, creative, entrepreneurial team, and we value initiative, good judgment, practical problem-solving, and follow-through over complicated processes and endless meetings.

The ideal person thrives in complex environments, knows how to prioritize, anticipates what needs to happen next, and takes genuine ownership of getting things done.

We don't need someone to tell us what needs to happen. We need someone who can **figure out how to make it happen, coordinate the right people, and see it through to completion.**

This is an execution-focused role. Success means vendors coordinated, orders placed, shelves stocked, signage installed, systems functioning, staff prepared, and an experience that's operationally ready to open.

Creative direction and major budget decisions remain with the founders. Within those boundaries, we're looking for someone who can work with a high degree of independence.

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* A brief introduction and your connection to Philadelphia.
* **2–3 examples of complex openings, productions, or venue launches you personally helped execute**, including exactly what you were responsible for and the outcomes.
* A description of your experience with vendor management, procurement, retail, and/or opening operations.
* Your availability to begin and anticipated rate or fee structure for an initial 30-day engagement.

**We're particularly interested in people who have helped bring unusual, ambitious, experience-driven spaces to life, especially within Philadelphia's cultural, hospitality, arts, or entertainment communities.**

This is a short-term, hands-on engagement with the potential to extend through opening.

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 30.0 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Location:

* Philadelphia, PA 19125 (Required)

Work Location: In person

02126867599ba5fcc62e.title: Senior Director, Global Security & Resilience
02126867599ba5fcc62e.description:
**Amentum** is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

The **Senior Director, Global Security & Resilience** provides strategic leadership and oversight of the organization’s global security and resilience programs, including physical security, travel and project security, insider risk, crisis management, and business continuity. This role is responsible for identifying and mitigating security risks; establishing enterprise standards and regional response protocols; and protecting the organization’s people, assets, operations, and reputation.

The Senior Director strengthens organizational resilience by ensuring the company can anticipate, prepare for, respond to, and recover from security threats and operational disruptions while supporting business objectives and maintaining compliance with applicable security requirements and standards. **This position is US Remote telework and US Citizenship is required.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the strategy, development, and execution of the organization’s global security and resilience programs, including physical security, travel and project security, insider risk, crisis management, and business continuity.
* Establish and maintain enterprise security and resilience policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks, with appropriate implementation at the business group, regional, and site levels.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate security risks and vulnerabilities affecting the organization’s people, facilities, assets, operations, and business activities.
* Develop and implement strategic security initiatives, including enterprise travel risk capabilities, business continuity planning, executive and Board security, physical security technology, and insider risk programs.
* Lead the company’s crisis management and business continuity capabilities, including the development of response protocols, crisis scenarios, exercises, and continuous improvement activities.
* Oversee the Travel and Project Security Program, including the company’s travel security risk platform and security support for employees and programs operating in higher-risk environments.
* Lead physical security operations and standards for company facilities, including site security assessments and development of risk-based recommendations and corrective actions.
* Direct the organization’s Insider Risk Program and associated prevention, awareness, mitigation, and response activities.
* Continuously monitor the global threat environment and emerging risks; assess potential impacts to the enterprise and provide timely briefings and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Partner with business and functional leadership to develop and implement risk mitigation and continuity strategies based on operational requirements and security risk profiles.
* Support business development, capture, and proposal activities by assessing security requirements, identifying operational risks, and developing security solutions that support customer requirements and company objectives.
* Develop and deliver security awareness and training programs that reinforce employee preparedness, duty of care, and organizational resilience.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of security programs, technologies, processes, and service providers and implement improvements based on risk, performance, and business requirements.
* Build and maintain effective partnerships with internal stakeholders, government and industry counterparts, security providers, and other external organizations to monitor emerging risks and support company operations.

e854b627fd13880b3fd4.description:
Overview:

**Location:** Fully Remote (Chicago, IL Preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Are you an experienced Program Manager who thrives on leading complex enterprise transformations and driving meaningful business outcomes? Trissential is seeking a **Program Manager - POS Transformation** to join our client's team and lead a high-visibility Point-of-Sale modernization initiative. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategic transformation program, establish governance frameworks, drive pilot deployment success, and introduce AI-enabled program management practices that elevate delivery performance across the organization.

If you're energized by solving complex challenges, influencing stakeholders, and building scalable delivery processes that leave a lasting impact, we'd love to connect with you.

**What's in It for You?**

* Lead a strategic enterprise-wide POS transformation initiative with executive-level visibility and influence
* Shape governance frameworks, PMO processes, delivery methodologies, and deployment strategies that will be leveraged throughout the organization
* Drive a high-profile pilot implementation and influence future rollout decisions across multiple locations
* Collaborate with senior business leaders, technology teams, operations stakeholders, and third-party vendors
* Utilize Microsoft Copilot and AI-powered program management capabilities to improve execution, reporting, planning, and decision-making
* Take ownership of a large-scale modernization effort that directly impacts business performance and customer experience
* Join a collaborative, innovative, and results-oriented culture that values accountability and continuous improvement
* Work remotely while partnering with diverse teams across business and technology functions

**Your Role & Responsibilities**

**Program Mobilization & PMO Establishment**

* Assess the current state of the POS transformation program, including project scope, schedules, stakeholders, vendors, dependencies, risks, and delivery health
* Establish a practical and sustainable program management framework within the first several weeks of engagement
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups
* Design governance structures, escalation pathways, decision-making processes, and reporting frameworks
* Implement executive dashboards, KPIs, status reporting, and performance-tracking mechanisms
* Create sustainable program management processes and tools that support long-term organizational success
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and execution alignment across internal teams and vendor partners

**POS Pilot Planning & Execution**

* Lead planning and execution activities required to achieve pilot deployment readiness
* Manage integrated schedules across technology, testing, operations, implementation, and vendor workstreams
* Coordinate store readiness activities, deployment preparation, launch support, and post-launch stabilization efforts
* Identify critical path items, delivery risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies
* Facilitate milestone reviews, readiness assessments, and go/no-go decision processes
* Drive issue resolution and escalation management to keep delivery objectives on track
* Capture lessons learned and establish repeatable deployment processes for future rollouts

**AI-Enabled Program Management**

* Leverage AI-powered tools to improve planning, scheduling, reporting, documentation, and execution activities
* Analyze program data to identify emerging risks, dependency challenges, and mitigation opportunities
* Create executive communications, status reports, dashboards, and updates through efficient AI-assisted workflows
* Improve knowledge management, documentation quality, and information accessibility across the program
* Enhance meeting preparation, action tracking, and follow-up management practices
* Identify opportunities to reduce administrative workload through practical AI-enabled process improvements
* Validate all AI-generated outputs against authoritative program information before executive distribution or decision-making

**Vendor & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Serve as the primary coordination point between leadership teams, business partners, technology groups, and external vendors
* Drive accountability for program milestones, deliverables, and execution commitments
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Identify delivery challenges early and recommend practical solutions
* Deliver transparent executive-level reporting regarding program health, progress, risks, decisions, and key milestones
* Influence teams and drive alignment without relying on direct reporting authority

**Tools, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Utilize Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Microsoft Copilot, and related collaboration technologies
* Develop repeatable governance practices, reporting frameworks, templates, and deployment artifacts
* Ensure AI-enabled delivery processes align with security, confidentiality, and organizational policy requirements
* Support knowledge transfer and long-term sustainability of program management practices

**Skills & Experience You Should Possess**

* 10+ years of progressive project and program management experience leading complex technology initiatives
* Demonstrated success establishing PMOs, governance structures, integrated delivery plans, and program controls
* Experience leading large-scale cross-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders and third-party vendors
* Strong expertise in schedule management, risk management, dependency management, issue resolution, and executive reporting
* Experience supporting testing, deployment readiness, pilot programs, implementation activities, and go-live events
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and presentation skills
* Ability to operate independently and deliver results in rapidly changing environments
* Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, and problem-solving capabilities
* Experience leveraging Microsoft collaboration tools and AI-enabled productivity technologies

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Direct experience leading Point-of-Sale (POS) implementation, replacement, or modernization programs
* Experience within retail technology, restaurant operations, multi-site deployments, franchise operations, or carwash technology environments
* Experience implementing enterprise rollout strategies across geographically dispersed locations
* Familiarity with change management and organizational adoption initiatives
* Experience utilizing Microsoft Copilot or other AI-enabled project and program management tools

**Education & Certifications You Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* PMP (Project Management Professional), PgMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project/program management certification preferred
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or related delivery certifications are highly desirable

**What We Offer**

At Trissential, we believe talented professionals do their best work when they are empowered to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact. By joining our client's team, you'll work on a highly visible transformation initiative while enjoying a supportive and collaborative environment.

* **Competitive Compensation –** You choose the model that works best for you, both with company-sponsored benefits! **$129,000-$139,000 annually or $76-$86 per hour.** Final compensation is determined based on skill alignment, years of experience, and fair, market-based rates by geography.
* **Comprehensive Benefits for you and your dependents –** Extensive Medical Plans, Dental, Vision, HSA with company contribution, company sponsored Life Insurance and Short / Long term disability insurance, a host of voluntary plans including legal, hospital, accident, pet wellness, and 401k with matching
* **Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off**
* **Career Development and Advancement –** Expleo is a global company in 29 Countries worldwide with a high focus on development
* **Strong Team Culture –** Collaborate with experienced professionals who value precision, performance, and teamwork

**This role is only open to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States.**

Ready to be part of something exciting? If you're passionate about leading enterprise transformation programs, driving successful deployments, and leveraging modern technologies to improve outcomes, apply today and take the next step in your career with Trissential.

4a8dc11241ec69da2842.title: Program Manager, Product Data Operations, Family of Apps
4a8dc11241ec69da2842.description:
The Product Data Operations (PDO) team provides the data, insights, and human operational rigor that power machine learning and AI at Meta. Within the Family of Apps (FoA), we partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to deliver high-quality data and evaluations that support product development and improve experiences across Meta's apps.As a Program Manager on the Product Data Operations Family of Apps team, you will independently lead multiple cross-functional programs that deliver high-quality data and evaluate AI model performance through AI-powered production and specialized human expertise. You will translate product needs into executable plans, determine the right mix of AI and expert-human workflows, and own program quality and delivery outcomes. In partnership with technical teams and domain experts, you will benchmark AI labelers, establish and maintain trusted evaluation datasets, calibrate automated judges, and monitor performance as models and product needs evolve. You will strengthen expert-reviewer capabilities and improve the tools, measurement practices, and workflows that enable reliable, scalable delivery. Throughout, you will turn operational and evaluation findings into actionable recommendations for product partners while improving quality, speed, and cost.This individual-contributor role requires sound judgment in ambiguous situations, analytical problem solving, and the ability to influence internal partners and external delivery teams without formal authority.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Product Data Operations, Family of Apps Responsibilities:**

* Own multiple data labeling, expert human review, and/or AI evaluation programs end-to-end, including requirements, milestones, dependencies, risks, and delivery plans
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to translate product objectives into dataset requirements, evaluation criteria, and measurable program outcomes
* Define and track success metrics for data quality, throughput, turnaround time, and operational efficiency
* use results to identify gaps and drive improvements
* Manage vendor and contractor delivery workflows and performance, including task instructions, calibration, quality reviews, and issue resolution
* Design and improve human-driven evaluation processes to assess model outputs, identify recurring failure patterns, and provide actionable feedback to product and engineering partners
* Identify, pilot, and scale LLM-assisted labeling and AI-enabled operational workflows, measuring efficiency gains and validating quality through human review and clear escalation criteria
* Develop reusable intake templates, tracking mechanisms, and process playbooks that improve the consistency and scalability of program delivery
* Identify tooling and measurement gaps, define requirements with cross-functional partners, and drive adoption of solutions within owned programs
* Analyze operational data and evaluation findings to recommend improvements to products, datasets, and workflows
* Align stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs, communicate progress and risks, and resolve cross-functional blockers to keep programs on track

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of experience in program or project management, operations, consulting, or a related role in a technology or consumer-product environment
* Experience independently leading multiple cross-functional programs from scoping through delivery, including managing dependencies, risks, and competing priorities
* Experience defining success metrics, analyzing data, and translating findings into decisions or measurable operational improvements
* Experience building relationships and influencing stakeholders across functional boundaries without formal authority
* Experience communicating program plans, results, risks, and recommendations to both operational teams and leadership
* Experience developing or improving repeatable processes and applying judgment in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience using Excel or Google Sheets for analysis, tracking, and reporting

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Understanding of Facebook, Instagram, and Threads products
* Experience integrating AI tools into operational workflows and demonstrating measurable improvements in efficiency or quality while applying responsible AI practices
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams on consumer-facing products
* familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, or other Meta Family of Apps products
* Experience managing data labeling, annotation, machine learning datasets, or human evaluation programs, including vendor or contractor delivery
* Experience with LLM evaluation techniques, including evaluation rubrics, reviewer calibration, error analysis, and human-in-the-loop quality assurance
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with SQL and building or specifying dashboards, reporting tools, or performance measurement frameworks

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$123,000/year to $179,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

**The opportunity**

The Recruiting Coordinator builds relationships with candidates, Recruiters, and internal professionals in-person by serving as a subject matter resource of EY Early Careers, facilitating event strategy, and maintaining communication with EY teams. Recruiting Coordinators are involved in annual or quarterly planning initiatives, vendor selection and communications, internal communications and instructions, and candidate communications and instructions. .

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Supports the relationship building process between candidates and EY professionals

f3d6d56996a4f2b82f4a.title: Test Center Outreach Specialist
f3d6d56996a4f2b82f4a.description:
**Test Center Outreach Specialist**

College Board - Operations

**Location:**

* This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

**Role Type:**

* This is a full-time position

**About the Team**

College Board's Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance user experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement (AP) examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s Recruiting team focuses on expanding access to College Board’s SAT Weekend assessments, recruiting educators and institutions around the world to open their doors and become test centers for students in their communities.

**About the Opportunity**

As a Test Center Operations Specialist, you will help make sure every student who wants to take the SAT has a place to test. You will recruit new test centers and help existing centers expand the seats they offer. You will reach out to schools, colleges, and universities in areas where testing demand is high, guide interested partners from first conversation through application and keep multiple concurrent recruiting activities organized and on track. Your work turns interest into real seats for students who want to take the SAT.

**In this role, you will:**

**New Test Center Recruitment (50%)**

* Conduct phone and email outreach to K-12 schools and higher education institutions in metro areas with limited testing capacity
* Respond to inbound interest from prospective test centers, then schedule and lead introductory calls
* Explain the benefits and requirements of becoming a test center, answering questions clearly and accurately
* Guide prospects through the application process and hand off completed applications to the test center establishment team
* Follow up with prospects who have not yet applied, using approved outreach scripts and templates

**Capacity Expansion Outreach (30%)**

* Contact existing test centers in high-demand areas to request additional seats for upcoming test dates.
* Carry out U.S.-based and international capacity outreach campaigns according to campaign plans and timelines
* Track seat commitments and confirm updates with the appropriate teams

**Pipeline Tracking and Team Coordination (20%)**

* Log outreach activity, prospect status, and seat commitments in Salesforce accurately and on time
* Prepare regular reports on outreach activity and results for the recruiting team
* Coordinate with fellow outreach staff to divide prospect lists and avoid duplicate contacts
* Share feedback from prospects and suggest improvements to outreach scripts and materials

**About You**

* Experience in outreach, recruitment, sales development, or customer relationship work, with 3-5 years of experience engaging and following up with external partners
* Comfort with high-volume phone and email outreach, including first-time conversations with people you have not spoken with before
* Clear, approachable communication skills and the ability to explain requirements and answer questions accurately
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage many prospects at different stages at once
* Experience using Salesforce or another customer relationship management (CRM) tool to log activity and track progress. Salesforce experience is preferred
* Attention to detail in record keeping and reporting
* Experience working with schools, colleges, or other education organizations is a plus
* A bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* The ability to travel 1-3 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

**All roles at College Board require:**

* A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
* Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
* A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
* A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
* A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
* Authorization to work in the United States

**About Our Process**

* Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.  

**What We Offer**

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

**A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation**

  

* The hiring range for this role is $48,000 - $80,000
* This role is non-exempt, meaning employees will receive overtime pay for hours worked above 40 hours in a given week.
* Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
* We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
* We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

6e0a00865288a8d40885.description:
#### **Evolve Psychiatry**

#### **New Patient Coordinator**

#### **M-F 9am- 5pm EST**

Remote, Applicant MUST currently reside in NY, NC, VA, GA, FL, IL, OH, or KY

#### **Job Description**

Evolve Psychiatry is seeking a highly organized, motivated, and compassionate New Patient Coordinator to join our growing team. This individual will serve as one of the first points of contact for prospective patients and will play a vital role in ensuring a smooth and welcoming onboarding experience.

The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced healthcare environment. This position requires someone who is comfortable handling a high volume of patient inquiries while maintaining professionalism, empathy, and efficiency.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to incoming calls, emails, and inquiries from prospective patients seeking psychiatric services.
* Assist new patients with the registration and intake process, ensuring all required documentation is completed accurately.
* Conduct Intake coordinator calls in which you obtain a past medical history on the patient
* Schedule initial appointments with appropriate providers based on patient needs, availability, and insurance participation.
* Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and eligibility prior to scheduling appointments.
* Educate prospective patients on the services offered by Evolve Psychiatry, including medication management, therapy, TMS, and Spravato treatments.

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. Paragonix Technologies, a Getinge company, markets organ transportation devices that safeguard organs during the journey between donor and recipient patients. * Maintaining necessary training and credentials for hospital, Paragonix, and OPTN computer systems.

* Excellent customer service and communication skills with both internal and external staff including relaying clear, concise, and pertinent clinical information.

* Responsible for being reachable within 5 minutes by telephone during their 24-hour call shift. Expert knowledge on usability of all Paragonix devices

* Responsible for working in collaboration with the rest of the team to train and evaluate new members.

* Excellent customer service and communication skills with transplant center recipients and family members.

* Appropriate pre and post transplant documentation within hospital EMR and the OPTN contractor computer system.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in health science, nursing, general science, or equivalent experience in transplant related field.

* 3 years experience in clinical transplant related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ABTC certification as a CCRN or CPTC

US BASED SALARY - The base salary for this position is $92,880.
  
  
#LI-JF1 #LI-Remote

We are seeking a highly driven, decisive, and solutions-oriented Freight Coordinator to manage over-the-road (OTR) and ocean container shipments. * Proven experience in dispatching, freight coordination, and logistics operations

* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and adapt quickly to changing conditions
* Strong customer service skills with a focus on responsiveness, communication, and issue resolution
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
* Strong understanding of transportation processes, regulations, and carrier operations

* Someone who takes initiative and acts quickly, even with incomplete information
* A professional who is comfortable with urgency, pressure, and constant change

1662716bf9ce0ccc7d70.title: Connectivity Partner Manager
1662716bf9ce0ccc7d70.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

**The Community You Will Join:**

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb's expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team's mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

**The Difference You Will Make:**

We're looking for an experienced Connectivity Partner Manager to own the health and growth of our network of connectivity providers, including channel managers, property management systems (PMS), central reservation systems (CRS) and other integration partners. You'll join the Global Hotels Connectivity team, which owns Airbnb's global relationships with hotel connectivity providers. Using data, automation, and scaled programs, you'll keep your portfolio integrated and compliant, improving connection quality and operations in close partnership with internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is a technical expert with strong project management experience, analytical acumen, and excellent communication skills.

**A Typical Day:**

* Own end-to-end connection performance across a network of connectivity partners, delivering day-to-day support through scaled programs.
* Build deep knowledge of technical integrations across PMS, CRS and Channel Managers, to provide targeted partner support.
* Use data to identify strategic opportunities and drive growth.
* Own scaled communications to all partners on feature updates, mandatory API changes, and deprecations, with clear timelines and next steps.
* Educate partners on product updates and share partner feedback with internal stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot partner technical issues to ensure performance.
* Develop and maintain technical partner resources that support field teams to self-serve.
* Represent Airbnb at external meetings and industry events, engaging with connectivity and hotel partners.
* Work with your team to design and manage projects that support the commercial goals of Airbnb and our hotel and connectivity partners.

**Your Expertise:**

* 6+ years of experience in a Connectivity Partner Manager or Technical Partner Manager role within a global technology or hospitality tech company.
* Strong understanding of hospitality/travel software; PMS, CRS, Channel Managers.
* Proficiency in SQL, Looker and Excel.
* Tableau, Asana, Jira and Salesforce experience preferred.
* Solid technical troubleshooting skills and project management experience.
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with confidence in engaging clients across multiple channels with stakeholders at various levels.
* Effective time management and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong quantitative skills with a proven ability to leverage data in decision-making.
* Adaptability to shifting priorities, projects, and deadlines.
* Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy—being an Airbnb host is a plus

**Your Location:**

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in **EST time zone** to be able to conduct their work. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:**

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you're applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.  
  
Rather than being aligned to a single product, this role sits within the Converge for Life Sciences commercial operations function and supports deal structuring, contracting, and client success activities across the portfolio's full suite of software and AI-enabled offerings.  
  
**Position Summary**  
  
As the Senior Consultant for Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Pricing and Packaging, you will serve as the commercial engine behind the Converge for Life Sciences go-to-market motion. You will own the full lifecycle of software license transactions, including all software license order renewals, partner with commercial strategy to design creative and innovative pricing and packaging models for software, technology, and IP offerings, and help ensure clients realize ongoing value from the platforms they adopt. Working across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Sales leadership, you will bring commercial structure and discipline to a growing, multi-product portfolio.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/23/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
**Deal Desk, Contracting & License Renewals:**  

* Own end-to-end management of all software license order renewals, ensuring accurate, on-time execution and continuity of client subscriptions across the portfolio.
* Lead the full commercial contracting lifecycle: drafting offering summaries, securing internal approvals, engaging clients, drafting license agreements, routing risk and legal reviews, and executing signed agreements.
* Build and maintain the commercial artifact(s) of record used to track deal status, payment milestones, and renewal timing across a staggered, multi-client portfolio.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for ad hoc contracting questions, coordinating with Legal/Risk on approvals so deals move cleanly from shaping through execution.

  
**Pricing & Packaging Strategy:**  

* Support the design of creative, innovative commercial models for new and existing software, technology, and IP offerings, including tiering structures, usage- and overage-based mechanics, margin targets, and contract exit terms.
* Partner with Product Management to establish a consistent point in the product development lifecycle at which pricing and packaging work begins, so commercial readiness keeps pace with new product launches.
* Build repeatable pricing frameworks and playbooks that scale as the software and AI-enabled product portfolio grows.
* Evaluate and recommend licensing structures (e.g., subscription, consumption-based, transitional/migration licensing) that balance client adoption with long-term revenue durability.

  
**Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment:**  

* Act as the connective tissue across Finance, Legal/Risk, Product, and Leadership on commercial and contractual matters, ensuring the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time.
* Partner with Finance on forecasting and cost modeling tied to commercial offerings, and support Legal/Risk in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions.
* Identify and help resolve cross-functional commercial issues that don't have a natural owner, bringing structure and follow-through to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations.

  
**Customer Success & Adoption:**  

* Partner with Account, Product, and Practice teams to support client adoption, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing messaging once a product is live, without duplicating relationship-management work already owned by those teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources, including practice expertise, product teams, and leadership, to resolve client-facing adoption issues and maintain a consistent client experience post-sale.
* Monitor client health signals tied to commercial terms, such as renewal risk or usage against contracted tiers, and proactively flag concerns to the broader account team.

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration:**  

* Comfortable operating as both a leader and a connector across Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal/Risk, and Account teams.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a staggered portfolio of concurrent deals, renewals, and client engagements at different stages simultaneously.
* Clear, confident communicator, able to bring structure to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations without a predefined playbook.
* Self-directed ownership mindset; comfortable being accountable for outcomes that span multiple functions with no single predefined owner.

  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
* 4-6 years of combined experience in deal desk, commercial contracting, pricing and packaging, sales operations, or customer success roles, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end commercial contract lifecycles, including drafting, approvals, execution, and renewal tracking.
* Experience designing or supporting pricing and packaging models for software, technology, or IP-based offerings (e.g., tiered, usage-based, or subscription licensing structures).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using commercial or contract-tracking tools to manage a portfolio of active deals.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Finance, Legal, Product, and Sales/Account teams to move commercial work forward.
* Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:  

* Experience in life sciences technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, R&D, supply chain, manufacturing, or market access).
* Familiarity with software licensing and contracting norms in a SaaS or enterprise technology business, including subscription, consumption-based, and transitional licensing models.
* Experience supporting or partnering with customer success functions on client adoption and stakeholder engagement for newly launched products.
* Comfort engaging with Legal/Risk teams in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions (e.g., demo licensing, exit/refund terms).
* Proficiency in commercial or product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Salesforce, Aha!).

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 - $207,800.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
