**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

The Manager, Product Ownership is responsible for conveying product vision and roadmap to an Agile delivery team by defining user stories and prioritizing product backlog. The Manager, Product Ownership works within specific guidelines and procedures; applies advanced technical knowledge to solve moderately complex problems; receives assignments in the form of objectives and determines approach, resources, schedules and goals.

The Manager, Product Ownership maximizes the value delivered by Agile teams by leading a group of Product Owners responsible for defining user stories, prioritizing backlogs, and making sure business needs are met. This role reports to the Associate Director, Product Management, and is part of a product team modernizing associate- and provider-facing capabilities and platforms through a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives.

The Manager will lead up to eight Product Owners. On the people side, that means coaching, development, performance, and team health. On the practice side, it means consistent product ownership standards, backlog quality, and Agile ways of working. The Manager is a key partner to business stakeholders, technology teams, and operations leaders, and helps make sure the right work is built, in the right order, within budget and on schedule.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Agile practitioner and people leader. They're comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy developing others, and can move easily between shaping strategy and driving execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of up to eight Product Owners, including goal setting, performance management, and career growth.
* Establish and reinforce product ownership best practices, including backlog management, story writing, acceptance criteria, prioritization, and value-based decision making.
* Act as the escalation point for prioritization, scope, and tactical decisions within the team's area.
* Take part in Agile and SAFe events such as PI Planning and help make sure Product Owners are prepared and effective.
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership to drive alignment and decisions.
* Find opportunities to improve team processes, tools, and delivery effectiveness.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

* Must be willing and able to support Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in product ownership, product management, or a related role in an Agile environment
* Minimum 2 years of people leadership experience, including direct management of individual contributors
* Proven ability to coach others on Agile and product ownership practices
* Experience in healthcare, managed care, or similar enterprise environment
* Experience managing priorities across several teams or initiatives with competing demands
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and find paths forward
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels

**Work-At-Home Requirements**

* At minimum, a download speed of 25 mbps and an upload speed of 10 mbps is recommended; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested
* Satellite, cellular and microwave connection can be used only if approved by leadership
* Associates who live and work from Home in the state of California, Illinois, Montana, or South Dakota will be provided a bi-weekly payment for their internet expense.
* Humana will provide Home or Hybrid Home/Office associates with telephone equipment appropriate to meet the business requirements for their position/job.
* Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading Product Owners or product teams in a scaled Agile (SAFe) environment
* SAFe certification (for example, SAFe POPM, SAFe Agilist, or similar)
* Experience with platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives
* Familiarity with Agile tooling such as Azure DevOps and/or JIRA Align

**Additional Information**

* As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we may contact you via text message and email to gather more information using a software platform called HireVue. HireVue Text, Scheduling and Video technologies allow you to interact with us at the time and location most convenient for you.
* If you are selected to move forward from your application prescreen, you may receive correspondence inviting you to participate in a pre-recorded Voice, Text Messaging and/or Video interview. Your recorded interview will be reviewed, and you will subsequently be informed if you will be moving forward to next round of interviews.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.  
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.  
$115,200 - $158,400 per year  
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 10-28-2026

**About us**
============

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

431daffe4fafbb733da1.title: Social Media Manager (Contractor) | Diablo | Irvine, CA or Remote (US)
431daffe4fafbb733da1.description:
**Team Name:**

Marketing

**Job Title:**
--------------

Social Media Manager (Contractor) | Diablo | Irvine, CA or Remote (US)

**Requisition ID:**
-------------------

R028327

**Job Description:**
--------------------

Blizzard Entertainment is looking for a Social Media Manager to temporarily support the Diablo IV Marketing team. This hands-on role will support the December 1 launch of Diablo IV Season 16 and maintain the ongoing social content cadence through January 2027, including the holiday period.

Working closely with our social agency and internal partners, this role will coordinate content production, reviews, approvals, and publishing oversight to keep day-to-day social operations running smoothly. The ideal candidate can get up to speed quickly, work independently, and maintain continuity, while also helping develop the Season 17 social agency brief using established templates

and guidance.

This role reports directly to the Director, Social & Content at Diablo.

**NOTE: This is an anticipated temporary assignment through January 2027. The candidate may be based in Irvine. Remote candidates within the United States will also be considered, provided they are able to work primarily West Coast hours (9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. PST).**

**This is a contingent worker position and will be staffed through Volt, a staffing and workforce management company.**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Maintain the Diablo social content calendar and coordinate schedules with agency partners and internal stakeholders.
* Track deadlines, deliverables, dependencies, and approvals to keep work on schedule.
* Support development of the Season 17 social agency brief using established templates and guidance; this responsibility does not include ownership of broader social strategy.
* Proactively flag risks, schedule changes, and blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned on next steps.
* Coordinate social creative assets across platforms and channels, including static, video, and motion content.
* Track production status, asset versions, delivery dates, and publishing readiness with agency and internal partners.
* Manage creative reviews and approvals through Opal, Blizzard’s social media project management tool.
* Capture and consolidate creative feedback, route revisions, and confirm required stakeholder approvals.
* Ensure assets meet platform specifications, safe zones, file requirements, and publishing standards.
* Coordinate closely with the agency’s community manager to provide guidance, secure approvals, and ensure approved publishing plans are executed accurately. The agency will handle the majority of direct publishing and community management.
* Serve as a primary operational point of contact for social schedules, approvals, and publishing coordination.
* Coordinate with internal marketing, creative, production, community, regional, and agency partners to keep work moving.
* Attend key planning and review meetings, communicate updates, and confirm owners and next steps.
* Maintain continuity across social operations by routing urgent needs and keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
* Provide occasional, scheduled operational coverage during Blizzard company closures or holiday periods, as needed, to monitor social channels, coordinate with the agency community manager, and escalate time-sensitive issues.
* Partner with the agency and internal teams to ensure coverage plans, escalation paths, and approvals are clear in advance.

**Minimum Requirements**

  

* 3+ years of relevant experience in social media, social operations, or content production.
* Experience coordinating social calendars, creative production, and agency workflows.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage deadlines, dependencies, and competing priorities.
* Familiarity with major social platforms, publishing processes, and content specifications.
* Experience using project management and creative review or approval tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external teams.

**Extra Points**

  

* Experience in gaming, entertainment, live-service products, or related audience-driven industries.
* Knowledge of the Diablo franchise, its community, and its audience.
* Experience working with third-party agencies and external partners.
* Familiarity with Opal, Sprinklr, Airtable, Asana, or similar platforms; prior Opal experience is not required.

**Your Platform**

Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, and StarCraft®, Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. (www.blizzard.com), a division of Activision Blizzard, which was acquired by Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), is a premier developer and publisher of entertainment experiences. Blizzard Entertainment has created some of the industry’s most critically acclaimed and genre-defining games over the last 30 years, with a track record that includes multiple Game of the Year awards. Blizzard Entertainment engages tens of millions of players around the world with titles available on PC via Battle.net®, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android.

**Our World**

Activision Blizzard, Inc., is one of the world's largest and most successful interactive entertainment companies and is at the intersection of media, technology and entertainment. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, World of Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, Candy Crush™ and Bubble Witch™. Our combined entertainment network delights hundreds of millions of monthly active users in 196 countries, making us the largest gaming network on the planet!

Our ability to build immersive and innovative worlds is only enhanced by diverse teams working in an inclusive environment. We aspire to have a culture where everyone can thrive in order to connect and engage the world through epic entertainment. We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered!

*The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.*

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to candidate-accommodations@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

**Rewards**

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

* Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
* 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
* Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
* Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
* If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/.

In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $89,280.00 - $165,168.00 Annual. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed. While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.

a49725756f7c7e6e4e5b.title: Telehealth Medical Assistant- Front Office Remote Position
a49725756f7c7e6e4e5b.description:
**Fountain is growing fast and looking for a motivated, Certified Medical Assistant to join our small team of medical specialists and entrepreneurs.**

Fountain Vitality Inc. is a tech-first telemedicine startup that focuses on delivering concierge, personalized telemedicine for select treatments like TRT/HRT and GLP-1 weight loss.

We have one of the highest Trustpilot ratings (4.9 stars out of 5) in the United States for a telemedicine company, because we go above and beyond to deliver the best possible experience unlike any others.

**Unique Medical Assistant Job – Work From Home!**

This is a fully-remote position, which means you can work from home. You'll help our existing team be more efficient, by handling operational tasks and making informational phone calls (to help us continue offering the best possible concierge experience to our members).

**Ideal Candidate:**  
The ideal candidate will have excellent organizational and customer service skills, experience managing data and documenting information in an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system, and the ability to provide professional, friendly support to patients both over the phone and via messaging. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, strong front office support experience, and an energetic team-oriented mindset. Prior experience supporting patients in hormone replacement therapy (HRT/TRT) or GLP-1 medication services is strongly preferred.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide exceptional front office and customer support to patients via phone, email and SMS.
* Assist patients with scheduling appointments, lab scheduling, intakes, etc.
* Enter and update patient information accurately in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
* Communicate with patients regarding appointment reminders, follow-ups, treatment updates, and general inquiries
* Support providers and RN team by relaying patient concerns, questions, and reported side effects in a timely manner
* Maintain professionalism, empathy, and positivity while supporting patients throughout their wellness journey
* Collaborate with clinical and administrative team members to ensure efficient office operations and a high-quality patient experience
* Assist with additional administrative and medical support duties as assigned

**Requirements:**

* A quiet home office area that meets HIPAA privacy standards (separated from other people in a room with a door)
* A desktop or laptop computer and a high-speed internet connection that can support video conferencing.
* **Certification with \*one\* of the following national organizations:** American Association of Medical Assistants, American Medical Certification Association, American Medical Technologists, CA Certifying Board of Medical Assistants, or MultiSkilled Medical Certification Institute.
* Front-office and back-office experience.

**Benefits:**

* Work 100% remotely
* Energetic team with proven track record

Fountain Wellness is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

If you're curious about us, you can see our website at Fountain.net

Pay: From $21.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a medical assistant certification? If so, please list the certification
* This is for a front office medical assistant position. Please list your experience working front office.
* When are you available to start?
* Are you comfortable working in multiple systems & multitasking? Please list EHRs you have previously used .
* Are you available to work any day of the week between the hours of 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. ET?
* This position requires a reliable laptop or desktop computer and a stable, high-speed internet connection to perform your job responsibilities. Do you have access to both?

Experience:

* Medeical Assistant: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

809901e32ee0e82be90a.title: Senior Administrative Professional
809901e32ee0e82be90a.description:
Colliers Engineering & Design is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Senior Administrative Professional to support the leadership team of the Highways & Traffic Engineering Discipline, one of the firm's largest and highest-performing practices. This role serves as a trusted operational partner to discipline leadership, helping coordinate and advance key initiatives that support continued growth, operational effectiveness, client service, staff development, and business performance across a national team.

This position offers a unique blend of executive support and operational leadership. While the role includes responsibility for traditional administrative functions, it also provides the opportunity to directly support and help advance many of the initiatives that drive the growth and success of the discipline. The successful candidate will help coordinate strategic initiatives, business development efforts, client management programs, recruiting activities, marketing initiatives, proposal pursuits, operational improvements, and other discipline-wide priorities while also providing high-level administrative and operational support.

This role plays a critical part in helping ensure important business initiatives, operational priorities, and leadership commitments continue moving forward despite the competing demands of project delivery and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating complex initiatives, managing competing priorities, driving accountability, improving organizational efficiency, and helping transform leadership direction into consistent execution.

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement; however, candidates must be able to work a minimum of three days per week in our Hamilton, NJ office to support collaboration and business needs.

  

* Coordinate and track discipline-wide strategic initiatives, business plans, operational improvements, and leadership priorities.
* Maintain discipline action-item logs and follow-up tracking to ensure commitments and initiatives continue progressing.
* Prepare reports, summaries, dashboards, and presentation materials to support leadership decision-making.
* Coordinate follow-up activities resulting from leadership meetings, strategic planning sessions, and business reviews.
* Support business development activities including client management programs, account planning efforts, CRM initiatives, and pursuit tracking.
* Coordinate business development meetings, action items, conference participation, and client engagement activities.
* Assist with proposal development schedules, contributor coordination, and collection of supporting materials.
* Coordinate discipline-wide resume updates and maintenance efforts.
* Support the collection and maintenance of project descriptions, project profiles, and qualification materials.
* Coordinate updates to website content, marketing materials, and other business development resources.
* Support project teams with contract administration, subconsultant coordination, billing support documentation, project startup activities, and other operational requirements.
* Assist with preparation and coordination of financial, staffing, and project performance review materials.
* Provide advanced project support including research, client relations, submissions, correspondence, transmittals, proposals, applications, reports, and other materials.
* Manage complex calendars, meeting schedules, travel logistics, and leadership commitments across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate recruiting activities, candidate tracking, interview scheduling, onboarding support, and workforce planning initiatives.
* Manage and oversee the use of Colliers Engineering & Design standards with all staff, including proper file structure, use of templates, file naming conventions, etc.
* Manage executive communications, including email organization, prioritization, drafting responses, and follow-up tracking.
* Complete additional tasks as needed.

  

* Associates/Vocational or related training education.
* 8+ years of experience in executive support, operations management, project coordination, proposal coordination, marketing coordination, professional services administration, or a related field. Preferably this experience would be in support of engineering, consulting, or other professional services organizations.
* Notary public preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong command of the English language, grammar, proofreading, and business correspondence.
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives involving diverse stakeholders across multiple offices and regions.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy while managing large volumes of information and competing priorities.
* Ability to create structure and organization in situations involving evolving priorities, changing deadlines, and incomplete information.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, track commitments, and ensure follow-through on assigned initiatives and action items.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively interact with executive leadership, project managers, clients, technical staff, and administrative professionals.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while balancing multiple responsibilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate needs and proactively develop solutions.
* Ability to read, write, and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

Compensation: $25.28 to $39.88 per hour (depending on qualifications)

ecb4d36322925b8d6d2c.title: Shipping and Receiving Coordinator
ecb4d36322925b8d6d2c.description:
**Facility:** Manfredi Cold Storage of Pedricktown, NJ

**Schedule:**

- Monday through Friday Weekends Included - Rotating Schedule

**Pay:**

**$16.00/hr and a $3.00 Differential for Closing Shift**

**Job Description:**

- Getting drivers checked in RTIC with orders provided by driver.

- Communicating with drivers and customers to meet special loading pattern/ requirements.

- Working with customers and customer service representatives to ensure MCS receives all orders, and get updates of possible delays.

- Assigning drivers to doors and explain them the Manfredi loading procedures.

- Send all necessary paperwork to the warehouse for loading, along with whatever else is requested by customer, such as temperature recorder, labels, pallet tags etc.

- Constant communication with the dock supervisor to get loading updates, to update memos for each truck as needed.

- Assist warehouse supervisors with any loading issues and communicating the problem to the customer.

- Working with customers to resolve loading issues.

- Assist with phone calls from customers, carriers and driver to help with their needs.

- Communicating with the yard jockey to get empty trailers or containers pulled out.

- Monitoring emails to help customers/carriers with their needs.

- Schedule appointments via phone call or via email.

- Checking all pending folders to discard any orders/inbounds that are no longer valid.

- Processing all inbound and outbound loads properly.

- Signing drivers out, providing them all necessary paperwork.

- Sending customers all the requested paperwork.

- File all paperwork at the end of the night.

- Turn off all computers and calculators at the end of the night.

- Communicating upper management if supplies are needed in the satellite offices.

**General Requirements:**

- Must be 18+ to apply

**Abilities Requirements:**

- Proficient in the English language to communicate with drivers and customers

- Good verbal and written communications skills

- Ability to be good at taking direction

- Highly focused and great attention to detail

- Must be proficient with general computer skills including Microsoft Software & email

**Physical Work Environment Requirements:**

- Standing for long periods of time behind a computer terminal is required

- Walk throughout facility to dock area is required

**UnitedHealthcare Insurance Company**

*Helping people access and understand their health benefits.*

UnitedHealthcare Insurance Company is a Connecticut-domiciled life and health insurance company with its statutory home office at 185 Asylum Street in Hartford. It operates within UnitedHealth Group’s UnitedHealthcare health-benefits business.

UnitedHealthcare provides health-benefit products and services for employers, individuals, families, Medicare beneficiaries, and people served through state-sponsored programs. The broader UnitedHealthcare organization focuses on making coverage more affordable, simplifying the member experience, supporting access to quality care, and providing digital tools that help people understand and use their benefits.

UnitedHealthcare works with members, employers, government agencies, care providers, brokers, and other partners across the health system. Its operations include plan administration, claims, member support, provider networks, enrollment, regulatory communications, digital services, and business analytics.

**Statutory home office:**  
185 Asylum Street  
Hartford, CT 06103-0450  
United States

**Business Operations Specialist**

**Location:** Remote within the United States  
**Work arrangement:** Fully remote under the company’s telecommuter policy  
**Employment:** Full-time, salaried, exempt  
**Schedule:** Monday through Friday  
**Hours:** Approximately 40 hours per week  
**Core availability:** 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Central Time  
**Salary:** $75,000–$95,000 per year, depending on work location, relevant experience, and qualifications  
**Incentive:** Eligible for an annual performance-based incentive under the applicable company program  
**Travel:** No regular travel required  
**Reports to:** Member Communications Operations Manager

Position overview

The Business Operations Specialist coordinates the production and delivery of required communications to UnitedHealthcare members. These communications may include plan notices, benefit updates, enrollment materials, coverage documents, and other approved member information.

You will manage deadlines, data files, approval records, vendor activity, quality checks, and delivery confirmation. The position requires strong organization and attention to detail, but it does not require clinical education or direct patient-care experience.

Primary responsibilities

* Manage communication requests from initial intake through production, delivery confirmation, and records retention.
* Build and maintain project schedules for member notices, benefit materials, and other recurring or time-sensitive communications.
* Confirm that content has received the required business, legal, compliance, and regulatory approvals before production.
* Coordinate with internal teams and approved print, mailing, fulfillment, and electronic-delivery vendors.
* Prepare and validate recipient data according to established security, privacy, and file-handling procedures.
* Review production proofs for correct content, formatting, version, dates, contact information, and approved regulatory language.
* Monitor delivery schedules and promptly escalate delays, data discrepancies, quality concerns, or missed requirements.
* Reconcile production and delivery totals against approved source files.
* Maintain organized documentation, approval records, delivery evidence, and audit-ready project files.
* Prepare operational reports covering volume, timeliness, errors, vendor performance, and unresolved risks.
* Participate in root-cause reviews and help implement corrective actions when production issues occur.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, improve quality controls, and make project status easier to understand.
* Protect confidential information and follow applicable privacy, information-security, and records-management requirements.

The specialist coordinates approved communications and production activity. Decisions about plan coverage, legal interpretation, regulatory language, or clinical policy remain with the appropriate subject-matter teams.

Required qualifications

* Two or more years of experience in business operations, project coordination, communications operations, vendor management, document production, quality assurance, or another deadline-driven administrative function.
* Experience managing several projects or work requests with overlapping deadlines.
* Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, lookups, conditional formatting, and reconciliation of data sets.
* Strong written communication and the ability to provide concise project-status updates.
* Demonstrated attention to detail when reviewing documents, dates, files, and approval requirements.
* Ability to investigate discrepancies and document how an issue was resolved.
* Experience working with confidential, financial, personal, or otherwise sensitive information.
* Ability to work independently and remain responsive in a remote environment.
* Authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience in health insurance, financial services, government programs, benefits administration, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting print production, mailing operations, digital document delivery, or fulfillment vendors.
* Familiarity with protected health information and HIPAA-related privacy procedures.
* Experience with SharePoint, Smartsheet, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, workflow systems, or comparable tools.
* Experience maintaining documentation for audits, regulatory reviews, or contractual requirements.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, operations, or a related subject.

A college degree is not required. Relevant operations, vendor-management, documentation, or project-coordination experience will be considered.

What success looks like

During the first 30 days, you will complete company, privacy, information-security, and process training. You will learn the communication intake process, approval requirements, vendor relationships, and documentation standards.

By 90 days, you should be independently managing routine communication projects, providing reliable status updates, and maintaining complete project records.

Within six months, you should consistently identify production risks before deadlines are affected, resolve routine discrepancies, and recommend at least one practical improvement to an existing workflow or quality-control process.

Performance expectations

Performance will be evaluated using a balanced set of measures, which may include:

* Percentage of communications delivered by the required date.
* Accuracy and completeness of production files and project documentation.
* Number and severity of preventable production errors.
* Timeliness of issue escalation and resolution.
* Quality of communication with internal partners and vendors.
* Contribution to process improvement and operational consistency.

Employees are not expected to sacrifice required review or compliance controls merely to meet a production-speed target.

Compensation and benefits

Eligible employees may have access to a benefits package that includes:

* **Health and well-being:** Medical and supplemental health-plan options, wellness resources, and programs supporting physical and emotional well-being.
* **Financial benefits:** Retirement and savings programs, a 401(k) contribution, employee stock-purchase opportunities, and applicable incentive or recognition programs.
* **Time and flexibility:** Paid time away, company holidays, leave programs, and remote-work flexibility under the applicable telecommuter policy.
* **Development and support:** Learning resources, career-development opportunities, reimbursement or discount programs, and company-provided equipment for remote work.

Benefit eligibility and available plans depend on the employee’s legal employer, business unit, geographic location, job classification, and applicable plan documents. Complete details will be provided during the hiring process.

Remote-work requirements

The employee must maintain a private workspace suitable for handling confidential information and participating in calls without unauthorized individuals present. Company information may only be accessed through approved devices, systems, and networks.

Employees must have reliable high-speed internet service and follow all telecommuter, privacy, records-management, and information-security policies. The company will provide the standard computer equipment required for the position.

Occasional additional hours may be necessary during regulatory deadlines, annual enrollment periods, or urgent production issues. These periods will be communicated as early as reasonably possible.

Hiring process

* A 30-minute introductory call with a Recruiter to discuss the position, remote-work requirements, compensation range, and relevant experience.
* A structured video interview with the Member Communications Operations Manager.
* A 45-minute live exercise based on a sample member-communication project. The candidate will review a fictional production schedule, identify missing approvals and data discrepancies, and explain how they would prioritize the next steps. No take-home assignment is required.
* A final video interview with representatives from communications operations, compliance, and vendor management.
* Final reference and employment checks, followed by a conditional written offer. Any legally permitted background screening or drug testing will be completed with the candidate’s authorization before the confirmed start date.

Equal employment opportunity

UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated businesses provide equal employment opportunities under applicable law. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process and employment.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**About the Company**

RoofMarketplace connects homeowners with vetted roofing and siding contractors and supports projects through completion. Contractors in our network perform the work, while our Project Delivery team provides day-to-day coordination, communication, and oversight to keep each job running smoothly.

**About the Role**

**This is not a field role and does not supervise crews or job sites.**

\*This position may be filled at the Manager or Sr. Manager level.

Our Project Coordinators serve as the central point of contact for homeowners, contractors, and adjusters, as well as the first point of contact for project escalations.

The Manager, Project Operations leads the Project Coordinator team and owns day-to-day execution, escalation oversight, and operational performance across a high volume of concurrent roofing and siding projects for multiple customers. This is a hands-on player/coach role for a strong, proactive people manager who sets clear expectations, builds a culture of ownership and accountability, and coaches directly while staying closely involved in daily workloads, project details, customer communication, and issue resolution.

Building on the existing foundation, this role will help shape the next phase of Project Delivery by further developing workflows, performance measures, documentation, and daily operating routines. The Manager will balance hands-on leadership of daily delivery with implementing improvements that support consistent service and continued growth. This leader will identify opportunities, prioritize improvements, and personally drive implementation- from building processes and developing KPIs to training the team and reinforcing adoption.

Success requires operational judgment, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to turn performance data and frontline observations into practical improvements in quality, timeliness, and fulfillment outcomes. The Manager works alongside Coordinators to model effective execution, resolve complex cases, and reinforce standards, while partnering cross-functionally to address systemic blockers and build a scalable delivery operation.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the Project Coordinator team as an active player/coach—setting clear expectations, monitoring performance, reinforcing accountability, and addressing performance concerns constructively and promptly.
* Provide frequent one-on-one coaching, live case reviews, and specific feedback, and model effective customer communication and problem-solving.
* Foster a team culture of ownership and proactive follow-through, where every open item has a clear next step, timely follow-up, and a clear owner through resolution.
* Coach the team to ask effective follow-up questions, identify root causes, and see issues through to completion.
* Manage daily execution across multiple customers and a high volume of concurrent projects, reviewing queues, aging cases, priorities, and capacity; rebalance workloads and step into frontline work when needed to keep delivery on track.
* Oversee project delivery from Work Agreement through completion, ensuring Project Coordinators secure signed Work Agreements, confirm scheduling, track milestones, manage change order submissions, maintain accurate records, and keep homeowners, contractors, and adjusters informed.
* Serve as the Level 2 escalation owner and oversee escalations handled by Project Coordinators, ensuring they are acknowledged promptly, actively followed up on, managed appropriately, and resolved in a timely manner.
* Step in directly when needed, ask the right questions to uncover the underlying issue, engage other departments to drive resolution, track trends, and address root causes to prevent recurrence.
* Identify and address delivery risks, recurring issues, and capacity constraints early; escalate decisions requiring leadership support and collaborate with Contractor Operations & Success when contractor performance impacts delivery.
* Evaluate current operations, identify opportunities, and prioritize a practical improvement plan while maintaining daily delivery.
* Personally build, document, and implement scalable workflows, standard operating procedures, handoffs, and escalation paths that account for customer-specific requirements; train the team, reinforce adoption, and verify that changes improve execution.
* Establish a disciplined, metrics-driven operating rhythm, including dashboards, queue and workload visibility, service-level expectations, and regular performance reviews.
* Develop KPIs and targets for quality, productivity, responsiveness, cycle time, escalation resolution, and fulfillment; validate data accuracy and use results to guide coaching, workload decisions, and corrective action.
* Serve as the team’s platform and tools subject matter expert, partnering cross-functionally to address root causes and improve processes and system capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience directly managing teams of 10 or more in customer-facing service delivery, project delivery, or operations.

**Required Skills**

* Strong people management skills, including setting clear expectations, fostering accountability, delivering direct and constructive feedback, addressing performance concerns, and making sound staffing and workload decisions.
* Experience leading high-volume, metrics-driven service operations with strong operating discipline, such as contact center, claims, or service operations environments.
* Skilled at developing KPIs, setting performance targets, managing to service levels, and using dashboards and reporting to validate data, identify trends, diagnose gaps, and measure improvement.

fd847c94d33233de4a3e.title: Account Coordinator
fd847c94d33233de4a3e.description:
**Hello #TruccoPeople!**  
Trucco is a family-owned importer and nationwide distributor of fresh produce, dried fruits and nuts. Founded in 1937 and headquartered at the Hunts Point Terminal Market (Bronx, NY), we operate a 200,000 sq. ft. distribution center in Vineland, NJ. Our programs include kiwifruit, citrus, grapes, chestnuts and more, sourced worldwide for year-round supply. Trucco is part of Orsero Group, one of Europe's leading fresh produce distributors.
  
  
**The role**  
As we grow our key accounts in the Southeast and on the West Coast, we are adding two Account Coordinators to keep those accounts running smoothly day to day. You will partner with our Account Manager and handle the daily details of our key accounts, so the Account Manager can focus on strategy, travel and growth. You will be the first point of contact for routine customer needs and the link between our customers and our operations teams.

### **What you'll do**

* Manage orders. Enter and confirm orders, track shipments and keep customers updated on delivery status.
* Be the first point of contact. Answer routine customer questions on availability, pricing and deliveries, and escalate bigger issues to the Account Manager.
* Coordinate with operations. Work with Logistics, the Vineland team and QA to keep orders on time and in spec; process claims, credits and adjustments.
* Support pricing and bids. Maintain price sheets, gather data for RFP/RFQ responses and send out crop and supply updates.
* Prepare reports. Pull sales and service reports, track progress against account goals and prepare materials for seasonal reviews and customer meetings.
* Keep things organized. Keep customer records and the CRM up to date, and help schedule meetings and travel for the Account Manager.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in customer service, sales support, or order management.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Eligible to work in the United States.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP or order-entry systems.
* Background in food distribution serving retail customers.
* Familiarity with produce seasonality and PACA.
* Experience supporting retail grocery or produce accounts, such as working with supermarket buyers, handling produce orders for retail chains, or managing customer communication around deliveries and claims.
* Fluency in Spanish.

  
**Benefits**  

### **What you'll find at Orsero**

* Salary of $70,000 – $90,000 per year;
* Health, dental and vision insurance;
* 401(k);
* Paid time off;
* A clear growth path toward an Account Manager role;
* The stability of a family-owned company with nearly 90 years in produce, backed by an international Group.

*Gruppo Orsero is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all people, in accordance with applicable law. We encourage candidates of every age, gender, sexual orientation, background, disability, and personal belief to apply.*

972759e83334da640c7c.title: Part-Time Program & Operations Coordinator
972759e83334da640c7c.description:
**About B Brave**

B Brave supports children and families affected by rare, incurable, degenerative neurological disorders. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and compassionate coordinator to support daily operations and coordinate assistance to families. This role offers the opportunity for someone to bring both heart and initiative to help grow programming that provide real, life-changing support to families.

This role focuses primarily on administration and family grant coordination, with additional support for programs, communications, and fundraising as time allows. This is a new position, and responsibilities may evolve as we learn what best supports our families and organization. Priorities and any changes to the scope or hours will be discussed collaboratively with the employee and the board.

**Administration & Family Support**

* Coordinate and track grant applications, updating the Family Tracker as grants are awarded and funds are distributed.
* Communicate with families to gather information needed to verify diagnoses, discuss grant allocation, and coordinate the distribution of funds.
* Track donations in Donorbox, maintain donor records, and send thank-you emails and handwritten notes.
* Request family testimonials and photos when appropriate and with permission.
* File and track expense reports, schedule meetings, distribute board materials in advance, and assist with other administrative tasks.

**Program & Fundraising Support**

As time allows and based on board priorities:

* Coordinate Comfort Cart supplies at three local hospitals, including ordering, occasional deliveries, and quarterly partner check-ins; maintain relationships with healthcare and community partners.
* Help coordinate social media content, campaigns, email outreach, blog posts, newsletters, and organizational updates, ensuring consistent, respectful, and authentic storytelling.
* Assist the board and event committee with the annual fundraiser, including committee meetings, venue and speaker coordination, guest logistics, raffle donations, corporate sponsorships, and the auction platform.
* Assist with other fundraising initiatives.
* Recommend improvements to workflows, systems, and programs, anticipate needs, and contribute ideas to support organizational growth and long-term planning.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through, with the ability to work independently, manage priorities, and seek guidance when needed.
* Compassionate, patient, and respectful approach to communication. This role will communicate with Families facing serious pediatric Illness
* Sound judgment, strict confidentiality when handling personal and medical information, and the ability to remain focused while working with emotionally sensitive content.
* Comfort learning online tools and taking a hands-on approach in a small nonprofit with evolving needs.

Experience in nonprofit administration, social work, healthcare, pediatric rare disease communities, fundraising, or event coordination is helpful. Familiarity with Donorbox or Auctria is a plus.

**Schedule & How to Apply**

Work is primarily remote, approximately 2–5 hours per week, with flexible scheduling. The role requires timely follow-through. Any additional hours needed for major projects or the annual fundraiser will be discussed in advance.

Please send your resume and a brief statement about your relevant experience and interest in B Brave to **admin@bbravefoundation.org**.

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 2.0 – 4.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

The LOB Executive Administrative Assistant, Executive Operations & Calendar Management, provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to Regional Vice Presidents and the broader leadership team. This role manages complex calendars, coordinates meetings and events, maintains critical client and regional information, and oversees contract routing and signature processes.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to anticipate executive needs while managing multiple priorities with professionalism, sound judgment, and discretion.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Executive Calendar Management**

* Manage complex calendars for Regional Vice Presidents, ensuring effective prioritization of business, client, and leadership commitments.
* Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings across multiple regions, time zones, and stakeholder groups.
* Anticipate scheduling needs and ensure leaders have the appropriate time, materials, and information to prepare for key meetings.
* Maintain confidentiality when managing sensitive business and leadership information.

**Meeting, Event & Conference Coordination**

* Coordinate meeting logistics, including scheduling, invitations, meeting spaces, technology, agendas, and supporting materials.
* Manage logistics for large-scale meetings, regional events, conferences, and leadership sessions.
* Support leadership team meetings through agenda coordination, material preparation, and follow-up tracking.
* Adjust meeting and event logistics quickly when business needs or schedules change.

**Client & Regional Information Management**

* Maintain accurate and current client contact information across the line of business.
* Manage regional email distribution lists, ensuring timely updates as employees join, transition, or leave the organization.

**BTA Administration**

* Coordinate established BTA procedures and administrative processes.
* Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation.
* Help standardize BTA practices across the regions.

**Contract Administration**

* Coordinate contract routing, review, approval, and signature processes.
* Maintain visibility into contract status and proactively follow up on outstanding approvals and signatures.
* Ensure contract documentation is complete, confidential and appropriately stored.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, Operations, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely execution.

**Executive & Operational Support**

* Provide administrative support to Regional Vice Presidents and the leadership team as needed.
* Prepare documents, correspondence, presentations, agendas, and other executive materials.
* Track key follow-up items and support timely completion of leadership commitments.
* Support special projects and line-of-business initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize administrative processes.

  + Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.

7286bf9b44939864e8cc.description:
**This position will be posted from October 26, 2026 to November 6, 2026 by 4:00pm.**

  

**Must be able to pass a drug and alcohol test and a background check.**

  

**DRPA and PATCO are subject to federal law, under which** **marijuana continues to be illegal.**

  

**Please check your spam or clutter for any emails regarding this selection process.**

  

**Basic Purpose of Position:**

  

Upon receipt of a requisition, evaluates the request, obtains quotes from vendors, and procures materials, supplies, services and equipment based on price, service, quality and warranty in accordance with the Authority’s policies and procedures.

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The Authority will adhere to all applicable laws and regulations in assessing an employee's ability to carry out or otherwise meet the job requirements set forth herein in a satisfactory manner.

**Major Responsibilities and Duties**

**DESCRIPTION OF TASK**
-----------------------

1.

Research product history and process requisitions for all goods and services requested by internal clients; and properly translate client requirements into non-restrictive specifications for competitive bidding purposes. This includes PA and NJ state contracts, GSA pricing and the competitive bid process Initiates procurement process that is in the best interest of the Authority. Factor in lowest cost, insurance, previous and current responsiveness of vendor in meeting specifications in choosing the procurement method. Verifies vendor against government listings of approved vendors.

2.

Analyze, evaluate and make award recommendations based on competitive pricing and specification compliance to determine award to the most qualified or lowest, responsive, responsible bidder, depending on procurement method. Draft formal invitation for bid and RFP documents and other required exhibits. Process all documentation required to award bid for final approval by Purchasing Agent or Director.

  

3.

Draft procurement contract agreements on behalf of the Authority. Support and draft FTA and Grant funded procurement agreements. Provide contract administration for DRPA/PATCO annual goods and services contracts including monitoring vendor performance, ensuring appropriate billing and payment schedules.

4.

Contact, solicit and receive informal quotes from appropriate vendors in accordance with all purchasing procedures, DRPA By-Laws, code of ethics, administrative regulations and vendor diversification program.

5.

Reach out to departments, troubleshoot and resolve problems and issues arising from purchase of services, supplies and equipment, while negotiating in the Authority’s interest. Prepares and processes emergency orders for goods and services for approval by Purchasing Agent or Director.

6.

Regularly assists in the development and maintenance of Departmental Standard Operating Procedures as directed, by reviewing and updating the same to ensure the accuracy of current processes.

7.

Supports the Authority’s Office of Business Development & Equal Opportunity Vendor Diversity Program by utilizing a procurement database which links goods and services with applicable vendors. Represent DRPA and the Purchasing Department at Office of business Development and EEO meetings related to contract administration and procurement.

8.

Assist in maintaining a safe and secure work environment by participating in required training, recognizing and reporting hazards and suspicious activity, and using all required personal protective equipment.

Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

**Core Value Competencies**

**Safety:** We promote safety in all we do. Our commitment to the safety of our customers and employees is paramount.

**Integrity:** We are committed to the highest level of ethical conduct, personally and corporately. We accomplish this by being open and honest, and by meeting our commitments to each other, our customers and our region.

**Customer Service:** We deliver the best, highest quality service to our customers because they are our primary concern. We provide quality service by focusing on both internal and external customers.

**Quality:** We value and recognize quality performance and strive for the highest quality in all we do. We accomplish this by monitoring our work, systems and processes and taking action to ensure that they meet or exceed standards.

**Teamwork:** We work as a team. We encourage our employees to develop and contribute their talents cooperatively. When one of us succeeds, we all succeed. Effective teamwork includes working cooperatively with others as part of a team- as opposed to working individually or competitively- to accomplish shared objectives.

**Communication:** We encourage communication in and between all parts of our Authority because we believe the free exchange of information is vital to unity, effectiveness and service among our employees, and to our customers and the region we serve. We are committed to delivering clear, effective communications and taking responsibility for understanding others.

**Innovation:** We are leaders in finding new approaches and encouraging new ideas. We welcome the exchange of new ideas to improve the Authority. We foster and initiate new ideas, methods and solutions to support the mission and objectives of the Authority.

**Dependability & Accountability:** We can be relied upon to do the work that's required every time. We are consistently at work and on time, ensuring that work responsibilities are covered and expected results are achieved.

**Self-Development:** We take steps to ensure continued learning and professional growth.

**Problem-Solving:** We accurately assess problems and effectively and efficiently arrive at excellent solutions.

##### **N/A**

##### **EDUCATION/TRAINING/EXPERIENCE**

  

**Required:**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED).
* At least 3 years purchasing, contract administration, or procurement-related experience.
* Knowledge of SAP Ariba or similar e-procurement software.
* Proficiency in relevant personal computer applications such as word processing and Excel or other spreadsheet application, including calculations and manipulating data and procurement related software.

**Desired:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, or a related field.
* Certificate in Public Purchasing from a nationally recognized organization.
* Governmental sponsored procurement/administration certification

f7018a5872a0be431e52.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

**Join the global leader shaping the future of PET imaging.**

At **Siemens Healthineers**, we operate the world’s largest PET radiopharmaceutical network — delivering over **1 million doses annually** with a **>99% fulfillment rate** and supporting more than 2,800 imaging centers worldwide.

**Important: This is a primarily** ***overnight*** **role.** Candidates **must be willing to work overnight** and have the **flexibility to rotate into alternative shifts** as business needs evolve.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Industry‑leading **5‑week paid training program** (in‑person + virtual).
* Competitive benefits: medical/dental/vision, **5% bonus**, **100% 401(k) match.**
* **20 days PTO + 5 floating holidays.**
* Meaningful work that supports patient care and advanced medical imaging.

You are responsible for the synthesis, quality control, packaging, logistics, and strict regulatory compliance of radiopharmaceuticals used in diagnostic imaging and treatment of diseases. Your role supports manufacturing through regular preventive maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting of analytical equipment used in operations. You also communicate regularly with couriers and customers to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of biomarkers. In addition, you assist with facility housekeeping, maintenance of laboratory inventory levels, creation of quality control documentation as needed, and adherence to strict safety protocols and regulations related to the production and transport of radioactive materials.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities**

* Operate chemistry instruments (HPLC, GC, TLC, and chemistry modules) and advanced systems (cyclotron) for the routine manufacturing and quality control of radiopharmaceuticals.
* Author and maintain precise documentation for manufacturing, quality control, preventive maintenance, customer support, laboratory investigations, deviations, and out-of-specification events.
* Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and troubleshooting of critical equipment.
* Prepare products for shipment, coordinate courier logistics, and provide customer support.
* Maintain aseptic environments (cleanroom) to create sterile consumables and prevent contamination during the production of injectable materials.
* Conduct environmental monitoring on a regular and defined basis.
* Maintain compliance with strict safety, sterile environment, and regulatory standards.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Specialized skill training or certification may be required.
* **Physical Demands:** Applicants should be comfortable working in a fast-paced laboratory environment and able to lift up to 100 lbs.
* Willingness to work overtime as needed.
* Detail-oriented with strong critical thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently.
* Basic computer skills such as spreadsheet, word processing, and email.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* An associate’s degree in chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Medical Technology, or a related Life Science field.
* Understanding of current Good Manufacturing Practices and Good Documentation Practices.
* Previous work experience in a laboratory environment or related role.
* Previous experience with analytical laboratory equipment and laboratory software systems.
* Familiarity with radiation safety or ALARA principles.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong command of Good Documentation Practices (GDP) to ensure data integrity and audit readiness.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, as well as critical thinking ability.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to treat confidential information with sensitivity.
* Ability to meet deadlines and work in a fast-paced, multi-priority environment.
* Ability to plan and organize job responsibilities and priorities.
* Ability to apply standard operating procedures (SOPs) in a production environment.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain a sterile environment.
* Ability to understand, prioritize, and implement laboratory safety protocols.

6904cd5d10055f7102fd.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Senior Manager is accountable for the safe, compliant, and effective operation of the Systems Testing Laboratory (STL) and holds overall leadership responsibility for all EMC, product safety, thermal-humidity, altitude, and environmental testing. The role leads the people, resources, priorities, quality, and accreditation readiness of the laboratory, and builds the technical bench needed to support medical and in-vitro diagnostic products through development, verification, and certification.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Laboratory Operations and Business Alignment**
------------------------------------------------

* Hold overall leadership responsibility for the day-to-day operations, strategic direction, and personnel of the STL, including all test chambers and all EMC, product safety, thermal-humidity, altitude, and environmental testing activities.
* Set testing priorities and manage laboratory capacity and schedules, translating business priorities into clear direction for engineering and technical staff and align laboratory work with project commitments and company deadlines.
* Manage resource planning, including inputs into project budgets, staffing, contractors, equipment needs, and facility requirements, and respond to changing business priorities with timely updates to overall laboratory testing plans.
* Be responsible for the quality and timeliness of deliverables to internal customers and stakeholders, including the Chief Engineers Office, Systems Engineering, Hardware/Design Engineering, Commercial Product Engineering, Manufacturing, and Customer Services teams.

**People Leadership and Capability**
------------------------------------

* Lead a team of engineers from diverse fields and ranges of experience, guiding professional growth through talent assessment, mentorship, and development of bench strength.
* Ensure all required laboratory capabilities remain covered by assigning and periodically rebalancing responsibilities among qualified personnel based on competency, workload, and availability, while retaining accountability for technical integrity, quality, safety, schedule, records, and customer deliverables.
* Own onboarding, competency development, documented qualification and authorization, cross-training, and periodic reassessment of STL personnel.
* Establish and maintain a phased knowledge-transfer and succession plan for critical technical and compliance capabilities.

**Quality, Accreditation, and Safety**
--------------------------------------

* Maintain laboratory compliance and audit readiness for ISO/IEC 17025, IECEE CTF requirements, and third-party certification body test lab (CBTL) audits, including controlled test records, competency evidence, equipment status, and technical documentation.
* Act on internal, customer, accreditation, and certification-body audit findings, ensuring corrections, corrective actions, and improvement actions are implemented, documented, and closed in a timely manner.
* Ensure equipment calibration, maintenance, verification, measurement traceability, measurement uncertainty, environmental controls, sample identification, configuration tracking, and retention of test records are effectively managed.
* Ensure the team's compliance with all quality procedures and policies of product development, and maintain laboratory safety, including electrical, high-voltage, RF, equipment, material-handling, environmental, and emergency requirements.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelors degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 7 years of System Engineering, Test Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and/or Software Engineering experience in a product development environment.
* Minimum of 3 years of technical, project, and/or people leadership experience in the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of EMC, product safety, and environmental testing for medical and IVD devices, with demonstrated experience with the IEC 61326, IEC 61010, and IEC 60068 series.
* Demonstrated ability to make risk-based decisions balancing quality, safety, technical validity, resources, and schedule.
* Critical and clear thinker with strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Practical experience acquired in an engineering product development environment, working across different product life cycles in design change and new product development projects supporting diagnostics products.
* Working knowledge of the product certification process, ISO/IEC 17025 requirements, and IECEE CTF programs, including audit response and corrective action.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills to work with auditors, internal stakeholders, CBTL, and national certification bodies (NCBs).
* Experience in project and technical planning of design change and new product development projects.
* Passion for people leadership, talent development, and knowledge transfer, with a continuous learning mindset and a strong commitment to quality deliverables.
* Ability to influence and work collaboratively with cross-functional, global teams, and to prepare and present technical and operational updates to senior leadership teams.

**Work Environment**
====================

* Full-time, onsite role located in Newark, Delaware.
* Hands-on laboratory and product-development environment involving test equipment, fixtures, and instrumentation.
* Occasional overtime, domestic travel, manual handling of equipment or test articles, and collaboration with global teams.

4b61ff00c4251ae3c5b0.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job SummaryProvides support for health plan provider relations activities. Supports network development, network adequacy and provider training and education. Serves as primary point of contact between the business and contracted providers within the Molina network. Responsible for network management including provider education, communication, satisfaction, issue intake, access/availability and ensuring knowledge of and compliance with Molina policies and procedures.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Successfully engages high-volume, high-visibility plan providers, to ensure provider satisfaction, facilitate education on key Molina initiatives, and improve coordination and partnership between the health plan and contracted providers.
* Serves as the primary point of contact between Molina health plan and the non-complex provider community that services Molina members, including but not limited to fee-for-service (FFS) and pay-for-performance (P4P) providers.
* Collaborates directly with the plan’s external providers to educate, advocate and engage as valuable partners - ensuring knowledge of and compliance with Molina policies and procedures while achieving the highest level of customer service; effectively drives timely issue resolution, electronic medical record (EMR) connectivity, and provider portal adoption.
* Conducts regular provider site visits within assigned region/service area; determines daily or weekly schedule, to meet or exceed the plan's monthly site visit goals. Proactively engages with the provider and staff to determine; for example, non-compliance with Molina policies/procedures or Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) guidelines/regulations, or to assess the non-clinical quality of customer service provided to Molina members.
* Provides on-the-spot training and education as needed, including counseling providers diplomatically, while retaining a positive working relationship.
* Independently troubleshoots provider problems as they arise, and takes initiative in preventing and resolving issues between the provider and the plan whenever possible. The types of questions, issues or problems that may emerge during visits are unpredictable and may range from simple to very complex or sensitive matters.
* Initiates, coordinates and participates in problem-solving meetings between the provider and Molina stakeholders, including senior leadership and physicians (examples include: issues related to utilization management, pharmacy, quality of care, and correct coding).
* Independently delivers training and presentations to assigned providers and their staff - answering questions that come up on behalf of the health plan; may also deliver training and presentations to larger groups, such as leaders and management of provider offices, including large multispecialty groups or health systems, executive level decision makers, association meetings, and joint operating committees (JOCs).
* Performs an integral role in network management, by monitoring and enforcing company policies and procedures, while increasing provider effectiveness by educating and promoting participation in various Molina initiatives; examples of such initiatives include: administrative cost-effectiveness, member satisfaction - Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS), regulatory-related, Molina quality programs, and taking advantage of electronic solutions (electronic data interchange (EDI), EMR, provider portal, provider website, etc.).
* May provide training and support to new and existing provider relations team members as appropriate.
* Role requires 60%+ same-day or overnight travel (extent of same-day or overnight travel will depend on the specific health plan service area).

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 2 years of customer service, provider services, or claims experience in a managed care or medical office setting, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

* Organizational skills and attention to detail.
