19acfdffd6856cf6e51c.title: Emerging Store Manager
19acfdffd6856cf6e51c.description:
**Job Objectives**
  
  
Supervises customer service associates and designated hitters. Responsible for managing front end of the store and making recommendations on the overall operations of the Pharmacy and Retail Store.
  
  
Supports Store Manager with the overall operation of the store to achieve company deliverables; Works alternate schedule with the Store Manager with minimal overlap; Assumes responsibilities of all store activities in the absence of the Store Manager. Ensures proper merchandising, protection of store assets, and improves store sales and profitability.
  
  
Leads and manages store team members, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, and discipline of direct reports to ensure teams are engaged and performing their responsibilities to achieve company deliverables.
  
  
**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer complaints in a timely manner and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Monitors customer service, provides coaching, training, and develops plans for improvements in both the front-end and pharmacy. Empowers team members to find the most impactful resolution for customers; seeks solutions that exceed customer expectations and builds loyalty.
* Accountable for improving on overall customer service metrics.

**Operations**

* Supervises the operation of the store and team members, including assigning daily activities, delegating tasks to team members, opening/closing/changing shifts, approving time records, time off and managing other scheduling conflicts to ensure proper team member coverage.
* Collaborates with external partners to drive the future of their Walgreen store. Identifies ways to support external partnerships and services as a resource for Pharmacy Operations Manager in seeking community outreach opportunities.
* Supports Store Manager in leveraging data, analysis, and team member input to make fact-based decisions, follow-up, and monitor impact.
* Supervises the control of the store cash management including but not limited to register counts, withdraws from bank, armored car pickups, safe deposits, change orders and oversees all aspects of bookkeeping.
* Supervises front end and pharmacy inventory, completing resets/revisions and price changes; analyzes front end and pharmacy inventory trends to create corrective action plans; trains/coaches team members to follow inventory standard operating procedures.
* Ensures execution of operational feedback from the Store Manager and District Manager through delegation and supervision of team members.
* Ensures that store interior and exterior are clean and presentable; manages repair and maintenance; responds to emergencies.
* Ensures team members have a working knowledge of all computer and technology systems and software.
* Provides for the safety and well-being of team members; effectively utilizes the Security Operations Center.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures, manages operations of assigned location including strict compliance with any and all applicable laws and regulations, including sale of alcohol, tobacco, fresh food, and pharmacy products.
* Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.

**Full Store Operation Business Performance Management**

* Independently analyzes financial and performance data; creates action plans to support achievement of business deliverables.
* Uses operating statements, key performance indicators, and other relevant tools to engage the team; drive solutions and actions for store improvement. Collaborates with Store Manager to identify sales opportunities, gain insights, to ensure growth and performance of the store through new initiatives as directed by the Support Center.
* Supports Pharmacy during busy periods, including serving as a pharmacy technician, when necessary.

**People & Performance Management**

* Primarily responsible for leading and training team members; provides training, mentoring, coaching, and support to enable team members’ career development. Responsible for team member discipline, coaching meetings, and makes recommendation regarding team member performance management, including discipline and termination when appropriate.
* Manages team member performance by assigning responsibilities, developing performance plans, setting goals and expectations, observing performance, providing feedback and giving recognition to enhance effectiveness of individual team members and overall team.
* Acquires and retains talent, builds pipelines to keep store properly staffed, and ensures a diverse pipeline of future leaders. Anticipates short and long-term staffing needs, develops talent plan, manages candidate pool, participates in the interview process and makes hiring decisions.
* Ensures proper procedures are followed for selection, recruitment, record retention, and training as required by Company policy and local, state and federal laws.
* Establishes a culture of accountability through clear expectations and performance management, Performance Improvement Plans, and constructive discipline.

**Training & Personal Development**

* Successfully completes Store Manager learning and development program. Completes all required learning and development courses, certification, and any training assigned by Store Manager, District Manager and company leaders.
* Monitors own performance, seeks continuous feedback from leader and team members, and commits to self-development; has an Individual Development Plan in place.
* Obtains and maintains valid pharmacy technician license as required by state.

**Communications**

* Communicates regularly with team members through one-on-one discussions, group meetings to ensure communication is open between leaders and team members. Actively responds to team member questions or concerns.
* Assists Store Manager in planning and communicating the company and store strategy.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Bachelor’s degree with a solid academic record, all majors welcome OR satisfactorily completed a Walgreens Community Internship Program OR High School Diploma/GED and two years of experience in a supervisory position (does not require experience with direct reports).
* Demonstrated leadership abilities that include professional business ethics, self-motivation, and strong communication skills and strong business acumen.
* Completion of Store Manager training program (LEAP) or willingness to complete Walgreens Leadership Essentials training (for individuals placed in ESM role on or after June 1, 2021) within 12 weeks of ESM start date.
* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English (except in Puerto Rico)
* Willingness to work flexible schedule including extended days, evenings, and weekend hours.
* Willingness to accept promotion into a Store Manager position, if promotion is offered, which could require relocation to a different store location.
* Ability to transfer to other Walgreens retail assets located within the same hiring Area.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Internal candidates: Management experience, including supervising others, managing, and assigning work. Experience across both front-end and pharmacy.
* External candidates: Business majors. Prior retail or food industry experience.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.

The actual salary within this range that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience and other relevant factors. 79a0854d0b9a66a7a192.title: RIS Team Lead / Manager
79a0854d0b9a66a7a192.description:
***Candidates must have direct, hands-on eRAD RIS Administration experience. Experience with other RIS, PACS, VNA, EHR, or imaging informatics platforms alone will not be considered sufficient.***

  

***The ideal candidate will have demonstrated expertise administering, configuring, supporting, troubleshooting, and optimizing eRAD RIS workflows in a production healthcare environment.***

Akumin is a leading provider of outpatient radiology and oncology services, partnering with top hospitals and health systems nationwide to deliver advanced diagnostic imaging and exceptional patient care close to home. With a national footprint, cutting-edge technology, and a strong commitment to innovation and patient-centered care, our teams play a vital role in improving outcomes for millions of patients each year.

**The Radiology Information Systems (RIS) Team Lead / Manager** is responsible for leading the engineering and support team tasked with the design, configuration, optimization, integration, and ongoing lifecycle management of enterprise radiology workflows across our RIS and PACS platforms.

This role combines people leadership, workflow architecture, and systems integration, providing strategic oversight and hands-on technical guidance to a multidisciplinary team of RIS analysts, workflow specialists, and integration engineers. Operating as a pivotal liaison between technical engineering, clinical operations, radiologist groups, and revenue cycle leadership, the Team Lead ensures that scheduling, order intake, prior authorization, exam execution, radiologist reporting, and billing workflows are standardized, resilient, scalable, and fully aligned with organizational clinical and financial objectives.

**Specific duties include, but are not limited to:**

**Leadership, Team Management & Operational Governance**
--------------------------------------------------------

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, mentor, and foster continuous growth across a high-performing team of RIS analysts and clinical systems specialists. Conduct performance evaluations, set operational objectives, and establish clear technical career paths.
* **Resource Allocation & Workload Prioritization:** Effectively manage team capacity across daily break-fix support, continuous workflow optimization, enterprise project deliverables, and major system rollouts.
* **Process Governance & Standards:** Establish and enforce best practices, standard operating procedures (SOPs), system change management protocols, and comprehensive documentation standards for enterprise RIS configuration.
* **Vendor & Stakeholder Alignment:** Act as the primary technical and operational liaison between clinical operations, IT/interoperability teams, revenue cycle management (RCM) leadership, and core software vendors (e.g., Royal Health, eRAD, PACS vendors).

**Workflow Architecture & Enterprise Standardization**
------------------------------------------------------

* **End-to-End Workflow Optimization:** Drive the design, standardization, and continuous refinement of end-to-end radiology workflows across multi-site and regional imaging centers.
* **Clinical & Revenue Cycle Integration:** Govern the architecture and maintenance of procedure catalogs (CPT/HCPCS codes), modality exam protocols, and scheduling rules to optimize clinical throughput, turnaround time (TAT), patient access, and clean claim capture.
* **Throughput & Bottleneck Analysis:** Identify operational bottlenecks, scheduling friction points, and communication gaps across sites; develop data-driven technical and workflow interventions to maximize modality utilization.

**Interoperability & Integration Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Interface & Data Flow Governance:** Partner with Interoperability and PACS teams to oversee and validate HL7, DICOM, and FHIR data streams (ADT, ORM, ORU, DFT, MDM), ensuring data integrity across EHR, RIS, PACS, VNA, and third-party portals.
* **Routing & Exception Handling:** Design and implement robust message routing rules, error queues, and exception-handling workflows to prevent dropped orders or delayed diagnostic reports.
* **Voice Recognition & Reporting Integration:** Oversee integration between RIS, dictation/speech recognition systems (e.g., PowerScribe, Fluency), and clinical distribution channels.

**Implementation Leadership, Migrations & Project Delivery**

* **Enterprise Migrations & Deployments:** Lead or support enterprise-level RIS migrations, platform consolidations, site expansions, and major version upgrades from conception through stabilization.
* **Project Lifecycle Execution:** Direct project workstreams including technical scoping, workflow mapping, configuration, user acceptance testing (UAT), training curriculum development, cutover planning, and post-launch hypercare.
* **Continuous Quality Improvement:** Monitor support ticket trends, key performance indicators (KPIs), and user feedback to proactively implement automated triage, self-service enhancements, and platform stability measures.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Professional Experience:** 7+ years of progressive experience in healthcare clinical applications, with dedicated expertise in Radiology Information Systems (RIS) and PACS ecosystems.
* **Leadership Experience:** 2+ years of demonstrated experience in a team lead, supervisory, or technical project management capacity.

**Technical & Clinical Domain Knowledge**
-----------------------------------------

* In-depth understanding of radiology business operations, multi-facility scheduling matrices, technologist workflows, and radiologist reading worklists.
* Strong command of healthcare revenue cycle dependencies, including CPT/HCPCS coding accuracy, ICD-10 cross-referencing, authorization capture, and electronic charge posting.
* Solid technical understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and protocols (HL7 v2/v3, DICOM, FHIR, IHE Scheduled Workflow profiles).
* Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools, ticket triage, SLA monitoring, and formal Change Management processes.

**Leadership & Interpersonal Skills**
-------------------------------------

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable operational strategies for clinical and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, forensic troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Proven track record of managing competing priorities and delivering projects on time in dynamic healthcare environments.

**Core Competencies**

* **People Leadership & Talent Development:** Inspires accountability, fosters a culture of collaboration, and elevates technical competencies across the team.
* **Systems Thinking & Workflow Architecture:** Connects granular technical configuration choices to broad clinical, operational, and financial outcomes.
* **Execution Discipline:** Drives complex multi-site projects, upgrades, and critical incident resolutions across the finish line with urgency and precision.
* **Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment:** Bridges the gap between technologists, radiologists, clinical center managers, and executive leadership.

**Why This Role Matters**

As our enterprise imaging network continues to expand, this leadership role transforms our radiology informatics infrastructure into an agile, scalable business orchestration engine. By harmonizing technical innovation, team talent, and streamlined clinical workflows, the RIS Team Lead / Manager directly elevates patient access, improves provider satisfaction, accelerates report turnaround times, and secures organizational financial health.

At Akumin, we invest in the well-being of our employees, so you can bring your best self to work each day. You can expect to see the following benefits:

* Competitive compensation
* Flexible scheduling
* Cross training opportunities
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA accounts with employer contributions
* 401(k) eligibility with employer match
* Paid holidays
* Defined PTO and sick time programs

Eligibility for benefits will vary based on role type and hours worked.

edb032c0b7b848d0b72a.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.  
Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for highly motivated individuals who would like to help us grow our business and bring a step change to procurement in the program advisory industry. You will have the opportunity to work with experts in the field of procurement, contracts and supply chain, develop new capabilities and work on some of the most exciting projects in North America. At the same time, you will be at the forefront of our thought leadership and part in the development of our toolkit.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on transformational, strategic or delivery roles on major programs. Some of the roles that you will be delivering include:

* Implementation of transformational initiatives:
  + Category management
  + Program contract development
  + Supply chain rationalization
  + Supplier relationship management
  + Supplier performance management

c8e19a8071b68d39ea6d.description:
Remote Interview Coordinator – Entry Level (Part-Time / Full-Time)

**Location:** 100% Remote  
**Schedule:** 25–40 hours per week, during U.S. Eastern business hours  
**Experience:** No previous recruiting or interviewing experience required. Training provided.

About the Position

We're looking for an outgoing, friendly, motivated, and professional individual who loves talking to people!

Our company provides luxury transportation and hospitality services, and we're looking for someone who can make an outstanding first impression on potential employees.

Your main responsibility will be speaking with job applicants, getting to know them, explaining our job opportunities, and helping us identify people who would be a great fit for our team.

Think Ritz-Carlton-level customer service. We want someone who makes every applicant feel welcome, comfortable, and excited about the opportunity to work with us.

You don't need recruiting experience. We're much more interested in your personality, communication skills, work ethic, and willingness to learn.

What You'll Be Doing

* Review incoming job applications through Indeed.
* Contact applicants by phone and schedule short video interviews.
* Conduct friendly, professional phone and video interviews.
* Explain our company, job opportunities, and benefits in an engaging and positive way.
* Ask questions to learn about each candidate's background, experience, and interests.
* Identify applicants who are reliable, motivated, personable, and professional.
* Record interviews with candidates' consent and provide brief notes to management.
* Recommend qualified applicants for a second interview with our management team.
* Follow up with applicants and keep them interested throughout the process.
* Help coordinate interview schedules and keep applicant records organized.
* Provide simple daily updates on interviews and candidate progress.

What We're Looking For

* An outgoing, charismatic, and positive personality.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with new people.
* A self-starter who takes initiative without needing constant supervision.
* Strong communication, listening, and customer service skills.
* A professional appearance and confident presence on video calls.
* Good typing skills and attention to detail.
* Strong organization and follow-through.
* Comfortable making outbound phone calls.
* Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently.
* Willingness to learn and grow with our company.

**Experience in hospitality, customer service, front desk operations, sales, or appointment scheduling is a plus, but not required.**

Work-from-Home Requirements

* Your own reliable computer with a webcam and microphone.
* High-speed internet connection.
* A quiet, distraction-free workspace.
* Good lighting and a clear video setup.
* Professional business attire during working hours and video interviews.
* Availability to work during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Software & Training

You'll use tools such as Indeed, RingCentral, Google Workspace, and Google Meet.

We'll provide a company email address, a company phone number, and training on our systems and interview process.

You do not need to know these programs before applying, but you should be comfortable using a computer and learning new technology.

Who Would Be Great for This Position?

You might be a great fit if you've worked in hospitality, customer service, inside sales, reception, or any position where you regularly interact with people.

We're looking for someone who can start a conversation with almost anyone, ask great questions, listen carefully, and make people feel excited about joining our company.

We value people who take ownership, stay organized, follow through, and always look for ways to improve.

Our focus is on finding great people, not just completing as many interviews as possible.

How to Apply

Please send a short 1–5 minute video introducing yourself, sharing any relevant experience, and explaining why you believe you're a great fit for this position.

Please record your video in a quiet, well-lit setting and dress professionally, just as you would for a virtual job interview.

Email your video to **ryan@acelimousinesvce.com**.

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time

Application Question(s):

* 1. Tell us about your experience and why you believe you'd be a good fit for this recruiting and onboarding role.
* Within 48 hours after submitting your application on Indeed please email a 1–5 minute video introducing yourself, sharing relevant experience, and explaining why you're the best fit for this role to ryan@acelimousinesvce.com.

Work Location: Remote

*Command Investigations, founded in 2012, is a nationally recognized investigations firm offering surveillance, remote investigations, desktop intelligence, and specialty services to the insurance defense industry. d0c566eb647067b93b44.title: Implementation Engineer - Quantum Networking & Security
d0c566eb647067b93b44.description:
Site readiness, deployment, integration, testing, documentation, and customer handoff

Location U.S.-based; flexible/remote within the United States, with frequent travel to customer and partner sites

Work Authorization U.S. work authorization is required

Employment Full-time Function Professional Services / Customer Engineering

Travel Approximately 30%-50%, including scheduled maintenance and implementation windows

Compensation Competitive base salary, delivery or company incentive, and benefits

Position Summary

Quantum Foundry is seeking a hands-on Implementation Engineer to own post-sale technical delivery from accepted design handoff through production readiness and operational transition. This role plans site readiness, stages and installs equipment, configures and integrates multivendor solutions, executes testing, resolves implementation issues, maintains accurate documentation, and prepares customer teams to operate and support the deployed environment. The ideal candidate has strong routing and switching experience, disciplined field-engineering practices, customer-facing communication skills, and broad exposure to optical networking, fiber infrastructure, cybersecurity, microsegmentation, encryption, QKD, PQC, and key-management integration

Key Responsibilities

**Review the contracted architecture, BOM, scope, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, POC results, schedule, partner responsibilities, and acceptance criteria before deployment begins.**

Lead site-readiness reviews covering rack space, power, grounding, cooling, physical security, fiber paths, optics, cabling, management access, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, certificates, monitoring, and change controls.

**Develop detailed designs, implementation plans, Methods of Procedure, rollback plans, test procedures, maintenance-window plans, change-control packages, configuration records, and as-built documentation.**

Stage, install, configure, integrate, and validate routers, switches, firewalls, optical systems, servers, encryption platforms, QKD equipment, PQC-enabled products, key-management systems, and supporting infrastructure.

**Configure and troubleshoot TCP/IP routing, switching, VLANs, segmentation, microsegmentation, VPNs, high availability, network services, monitoring, logging, and management connectivity.**

Validate optical and fiber readiness, including connector condition, patching, optics, wavelength plans, end-to-end loss measurements, attenuation, receive levels, continuity, and transport dependencies.

**Integrate QKD systems and key-management components with customer PKI, HSMs, certificates, encryptors, routing and switching infrastructure, firewalls, identity platforms, monitoring systems, and change-management processes.**

Implement and validate cybersecurity controls, including secure management, access controls, microsegmentation, firewall policy, logging, certificate handling, and secure configuration practices.

**Execute functional, interoperability, resiliency, security, performance, failure-recovery, and acceptance testing; collect evidence and manage defects and remediation through closure.**

Troubleshoot complex network, optical, fiber, cryptographic, software, API, configuration, and performance issues and coordinate escalation with OEMs, carriers, partners, and internal resources.

**Own the field implementation workstream, including technical schedule, daily status, risks, issues, dependencies, customer communications, scope control, and readiness for go-live.**

Deliver administrator training, knowledge transfer, operational runbooks, as-built records, customer acceptance materials, and a structured handoff to operations and support.

**Support post-go-live stabilization and capture lessons learned, product defects, and reusable improvements for future deployments.**

Required Qualifications

**Five or more years of experience implementing, integrating, testing, or supporting enterprise network, security, data-center, or infrastructure solutions in customer environments.**

Hands-on expertise in TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, LAN/WAN, VPNs, segmentation, high availability, network services, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

**Experience with site-readiness assessment, equipment staging, installation, configuration, change control, cutover support, rollback, and customer acceptance.**

Ability to develop MOPs, low-level designs, test procedures, rollback plans, as-built documentation, operational runbooks, and customer training materials.

**Strong customer communication and project discipline, including the ability to explain risks, manage technical expectations, and coordinate multiple contributors.**  Ability to travel regularly to customer locations and support scheduled maintenance windows, including evenings or weekends when required.

**Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, electrical engineering, telecommunications, information technology, physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.**

U.S. work authorization and the ability to travel within the United States for implementation activity.

Desired Experience

**Optical networking and fiber infrastructure, including DWDM, coherent transport, optical power and loss measurements, attenuation, fiber inspection, cleaning, troubleshooting, and test equipment.**

Cybersecurity implementation involving firewalls, zero trust, network access control, microsegmentation, PKI, certificates, TLS, IPsec, identity, secure management, logging, or vulnerability remediation.

**QKD architectures and operations, PQC-enabled technologies, crypto-agility, key-management systems, HSMs, network encryptors, or hybrid cryptography.**

Integration of QKD or external key-management systems using certificates, APIs, ETSI interfaces, or vendor-specific protocols. **Juniper, Cisco, Arista, Nokia, Ciena, HPE Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, F5, Kentik, or comparable platforms.**  Python, shell scripting, APIs, configuration management, automation, test harnesses, or infrastructure-as-code. **NIST PQC standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA and guidance related to quantum-safe migration.**  Relevant networking, cybersecurity, cloud, Linux, optical, or project-delivery certifications.

Measures of Success **Deployments are completed safely, on schedule, within approved scope, and against documented acceptance criteria.**  Site-readiness gaps and delivery dependencies are identified early and managed effectively. **Functional and performance testing succeeds with limited rework and disciplined defect closure.**  Customer documentation, as-built records, training, and support handoff are complete and usable. **Post-go-live stabilization is efficient and customer operations teams are prepared to manage the solution.**  Reusable automation, configurations, MOPs, and delivery playbooks reduce future deployment effort.

About Quantum Foundry Quantum Foundry helps commercial, public-sector, research, and education organizations modernize enterprise infrastructure while preparing for quantum-era security and computing. The company integrates networking, optical transport, cybersecurity, data-center, QKD, PQC, professional services, and managed services into practical customer solutions. Application Information

Submit a resume and a brief summary of relevant customer-facing engineering experience to https://quantumfoundry.ai/careers-1

All jobs at Southern Champion Tray (SCT) require Team members to act in accordance with the shared Core Values and Operating principles of the company as they perform specific job functions. These include:

* Trustworthy – We strive for our actions to match our words in all our relationships.
* Servant–Hearted – We enable and empower our team to serve the needs of customers, Team members, suppliers, and the community.
* Relational – We aim to build healthy relationships while fostering an environment that promotes compassion, balance, and personal and professional growth.
* Resourceful – We value strategic insourcing, first looking to create solutions internally, and then looking to apply that knowledge to future opportunities.

**REMOTE WORK ELIGIBILITY:**

This position will function primarily remotely within approved geographic locations, with periodic travel required. Availability for scheduled weekly, monthly, and other company sales meetings, Corporate Accounts Team, Sales Leadership Team, and Chattanooga Leadership Team meetings in person or via Teams or other virtual call software options is expected. Reasonable response time to requests from various sources is also expected.

**SUMMARY**

Responsible for managing full strategic sales and business development for distribution accounts based within the United States as well as generating demand through targeted end-user engagement. This person will represent Southern Champion Tray stock catalog products, in addition to custom packaging. Primarily responsible for maintaining existing customer relationships and developing new end-user relationships, in an effort to increase annual sales within our current distribution network.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Successfully manages accounts to achieve growth, hit sales targets, and meet overall annual budgeting requirements for territory
* Proactively identifies, targets, and calls on key operator end users across restaurant, grocery, convenience store (c-store), and commercial/retail bakery markets to uncover packaging pain points and generate pull-through demand for distributor partners
* Conducts on-site product demonstrations, packaging audits, and sample evaluations for restaurant operators, supermarket deli/bakery directors, c-store category managers, and retail bakeries to present functional SCT stock and custom packaging alternatives
* Maintains an active pipeline of end-user conversion targets within the restaurant, grocery, c-store, and bakery sectors, coordinating with local distributor sales representatives to seamlessly fulfill and close new operator business
* Effectively works with Sales Manager on a daily/weekly basis
* Effectively submits and evaluates pricing to ensure competitiveness in the market
* Collaborates with customers and marketing teams to drive business
* Performs analysis for Quarterly and Annually Business Review Meetings with top customers
* Travels monthly within territory to participate in tradeshows, lead sales presentations, and end-user calls
* Identifies and develops a portfolio of high-value customers
* Cultivates strong customer relationships with key business executives
* Learns product line and manufacturing process and stays up to date on that knowledge to emphasize product features to use in problem solving strategies for customers to grow business and relationships
* Maintains contacts and projects in Sales Pipeline Tool and WebCenter
* Analyzes current and prospective customer accounts for profitability performance
* Onboards new customers to help them understand the full scope of company products, programs and services
* Negotiates product contracts and close agreements to maximize profits
* Participates in customer product Request for Quotes (RFQs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and meets deadlines
* Serves as a brand ambassador for existing and new products and develops tailored sales pitches to each customer
* Participates in the development and implementation of a strategic business account plan for territory sales that aligns with SCT’s overall business strategy
* Plans in advance and coordinates trade show representative(s) in absence of Account Manager or due to conflicting schedules
* Participates and leads sales presentations at customer events and industry tradeshows
* Utilizes sales reporting tools to assist in development of realistic forecasts for production planning purposes
* Collaborates with customers and internal teams to produce customized packaging
* Partners with Distributor Sales Reps to train them on our product lines and acquires new business for SCT and our customers, including planning and executing joint end-user sales calls.
* Reinforces positive relationships with prospective and existing customers through face-to-face meetings, events, and frequent communications
* Remains current with product and industry marketing trends such as sustainable packaging shifts, off-premise dining trends, prepared food growth, and grab – and-go foodservice needs.
* Resolves escalated customer issues and complaints regarding sales and service in a way that honors the customer and aligns with SCT’s mission, vision, and core values
* Assists with development of contracts and agreements for customers
* Seeks resolution and responds promptly to any product, service, and billing related issues
* Sets a good example, acts in accordance with company culture and values, prioritizes effectively, uses effective communication, and delivers results efficiently
* Provides superior service to external and internal customers
* Submits weekly sales updates which consist of account activities and weekly expense reports
* Maintains company vehicle, if provided, communicates any maintenance needs, and resolves these needs when necessary
* Cascades and communicates with individuals at all levels within the organization
* Documents assigned tasks as required
* Performs work according to supervisor's directives when requested
* Wears safety protection as required by company and/or customer
* Ensures a clean workplace daily
* Performs other duties as assigned

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

**DEVELOPMENT INDICATORS**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required, bachelor’s degree in business management or similar professional experience preferred
* Minimum five (5) years’ sales experience with emphasis on packaging and/or distribution preferred
* Prior experience selling into foodservice, restaurant, grocery, or bakery markets strongly preferred.

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS**

* Eighteen (18) years of age or older
* Successful completion of pre-employment drug screen, physical and background check
* Dependability
* Valid driver's license
* Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle
* Willingness to travel frequently by air and land
* Sufficient personal financial resources to make travel arrangements, etc. between monthly company reimbursement cycles. Approved expenses will be reimbursed.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED**

* Basic computer/typing skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office software applications (Word, Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint)
* Strong interpersonal and communication (both verbal and written) skills and ability to effectively deliver, reinforce consistent messages and influence others via communication to get desired results at all levels of the organization
* Excellent relationship-building skills
* Skilled at building rapport, opening doors, and understanding business requirements of customers at all levels from distributor management to independent and multi-unit food service operator decision-makers
* Strong analytical skills/logical reasoning ability
* Ability to use data-driven reports to facilitate sales growth, provide forecasts to production planning teams, etc.
* Ability to prioritize, organize and multitask well, paying close attention to detail and effectively managing time
* Independent thinker/worker with strong initiative to lead/manage multiple projects under minimal supervision
* Excellent public speaking and presentation skills
* Willingness to travel frequently

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to read, understand, and communicate to others the meaning of complex documents including legal documents, letters, etc. and write legibly in English
* Ability to understand, speak clearly, and communicate in English
* Bilingual speaking ability a plus

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide both fractions and decimals, solve equations, read measurements
* Ability to use formulas to calculate and analyze data

**REASONING ABILITY**

* Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* While performing the duties of this job, regularly required to remain in a stationary position a minimum of 25% of the time, move and regularly operate a computer and other office equipment and properly employ objects, tools and/or controls. Frequently required to communicate and exchange accurate information.
* While performing the duties of this job, regularly required to walk, stand, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls and reach with arms and hands.
* Specific vision abilities include close vision, color vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Must frequently transport up to ten (10) pounds and occasionally transport up to twenty-five (25) pounds. Lifting devices must be used or help must be requested for anything over twenty-five (25) pounds.
* Ability to frequently travel by land and/or air for extended periods of time with overnight stays.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and cannot be eliminated or performed by others.

483dd71cb54d79214bb8.description:
At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.

As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency.

At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you.

**Why Offchain?**

Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.

Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.

Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.

To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.

### **What is the role:**

Offchain is looking for a strategic, hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive go-to-market and growth for ZeroDev, our smart account and wallet infrastructure for developers, fintechs and financial institutions building programmable finance. This role is made for a builder who thrives at the intersection of product, sales and growth, and who can connect every campaign to pipeline and revenue.

This is a full-stack role. One week you're shipping a launch; the next you're working in HubSpot and supporting commercial proposals with Sales. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales and the wider Offchain marketing team to shape positioning, run campaigns and grow ZeroDev's footprint with both crypto-native builders and enterprise buyers.

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop product positioning, messaging and competitive framing across the ZeroDev product line, and evolve it as products mature.
* Define go-to-market plans and run launches end to end, developing content for landing pages, blogs, emails, demos, social, one-pagers and internal enablement.
* Run content, search and lifecycle programs. Own the X and LinkedIn calendar, SEO and answer-engine visibility, the monthly newsletter, nurture flows and customer case studies.
* Own growth operations: HubSpot administration, lead scoring and routing, campaign tracking (UTMs, PostHog) and funnel dashboards.
* Equip Sales with proposals, battlecards, account briefs and discovery prompts grounded in the product to assist in moving customers through the pipeline .
* Collaborate with ecosystem partners to drive adoption and amplify reach through coordinated GTM efforts.
* Contribute to OKRs and performance tracking frameworks, and manage marketing budget and paid campaigns against named opportunities.

### **What you'll need:**

* 5+ years of experience in product marketing or a similar function in crypto, fintech, or developer tools and infrastructure
* Demonstrated success launching and scaling product launches end to end, with quantifiable outcomes
* Strong copywriting and storytelling skills - able to distill complexity into clarity
* Hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, lead scoring, pipelines and reporting
* Analytical in nature, with a strong ability to set up tracking, read funnels and tie marketing work to pipeline and revenue
* Comfort navigating ambiguity and solving open-ended problems with structure and insight
* Daily AI tool user who can build simple agent workflows or automations
* Blockchain Enthusiast. A burning curiosity and/or deep understanding of blockchain technologies
* **Bonus:** Experience managing and mentoring team members, fostering a collaborative environment that drives individual growth and team success

### **Perks:**

* Remote-first global workforce + NY office
* Professional reimbursement program (facilitates industry conference attendance, certifications, and more)
* Medical, dental & vision coverage (US + some other countries)
* 401k retirement plan + company match (US only)
* Wellness stipend
* Home office set up / ergonomic equipment program

**Attention Offchain Job Seekers:**

This role cannot be performed in California, or Colorado.

Please be advised that there has been a rise in fraudulent recruiter activities, particularly within the Web3 space. If you would like to confirm whether someone is an Offchain employee or the legitimacy of an offer you received, please email jobs@offchainlabs.com

At Offchain, we are committed to building a welcoming and supportive workplace for all employees, regardless of their background or identity. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued and has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive. We encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply and join our team.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

### **Overview**

NextPlay Recruitment is adding a Business Development Representative to our internal team. This is a role for someone who likes to open doors: find businesses that are hiring, start the conversation, and set up discovery calls for our leadership team. Every meeting you book is a company that gets real help with its hiring, and a win you can point to.

You are the first voice most new clients hear from NextPlay. You will spend your days reaching out to owners, HR leaders, and hiring managers, learning what they need, and showing them how a recruiting partner takes the hiring load off their plate.

### **What You'll Do**

* Research and build lists of companies that are actively hiring in our target industries
* Reach out by phone, email, and LinkedIn to introduce NextPlay and start conversations
* Respond quickly to inbound inquiries from our website and social channels
* Qualify each opportunity by learning the company's open roles, timeline, and hiring challenges
* Book discovery calls for leadership and make sure every meeting is confirmed and prepared
* Follow up with prospects who were not ready yet and keep them warm over time
* Keep every contact, note, and next step current in our CRM
* Share what you hear from the market so we can sharpen our messaging and services

### **Who Fits**

* One or more years in sales, business development, lead generation, or a client-facing role
* Comfortable making outbound calls and writing short, professional emails
* Curious about how businesses hire and genuinely interested in solving their problems
* Organized, self-directed, and consistent with follow-up
* Confident with a CRM, LinkedIn, and basic spreadsheets, or quick to learn them
* Experience in staffing, recruiting, or B2B services is a plus and not required
* A quiet home workspace with reliable high-speed internet
* Authorization to work in the United States

### **What's Offered**

* A full-time, fully remote, salaried position on the NextPlay Recruitment team
* Base salary of $60,000 to $75,000 per year, based on experience
* Performance bonuses tied to the meetings you book and the clients who come on board
* A clear outreach process, scripts, and templates to start strong from week one
* Direct work with company leadership and a real voice in how we grow
* Room to grow into senior business development or account management as the team expands

NextPlay Recruitment provides reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. To request one, reach us through the Contact page on this site.

### **About NextPlay Recruitment**

NextPlay Recruitment helps businesses find, engage, and hire the people who move them forward. NextPlay Recruitment is an equal opportunity employer.

**Position Title:** Inside Sales Representative

**Reports To:** Director, Inside Sales

**Department:** Inside Sales

**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full-Time

**About Us**

Revision Skincare® Where Skin Longevity Begins™

Revision Skincare® is a leading professional skincare company dedicated to advancing skin health through innovative, science-backed solutions. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration, and a passion for excellence. As part of our team, you'll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to research, innovation, and delivering measurable results for customers and healthcare professionals worldwide.

At Revision, we look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future.

**Role Overview**

Under general supervision of the Director of Inside Sales, the ISR is responsible for selling, training, and presenting promotional sales within their existing accounts. Based out of the corporate office or remote the Inside Sales Representative will work cooperatively with the Director of Inside Sales, Regional Sales Director, Customer Service Representatives, Business Development Managers, and other team members to achieve corporate initiatives.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Market and sell all Revision Skincare product lines in assigned client base in compliance with established strategies

* Understanding and use of customer management system

* Responsible to grow and prospect in all accounts assigned to you as “inside” accounts. Expected to meet and exceed both sales targets and new account growth goals for assigned states as an Inside Sales Representative.

* Acting in a sales support role, actively partner with BDM’s on your regional team to impact quota and sales numbers. Calling on their accounts as determined for sales and/or training needs.

* Establish and maintain positive relationships with all clients and all coworkers in all departments.

* Deliver training of Revision Skincare products and sales tools either virtually or in person as needed to accounts and prospective customers.

* Open new accounts and actively manage sales in assigned “vacant” territories in assigned region to assist that region to monthly/quarterly goals. Transition new BDM into that territory.

* Responsible to meet and exceed monthly/quarterly goals to hunt, qualify and nurture self-generated leads for each AE in your assigned region resulting in new account acquisition.

* Attend inside sales, regional calls and meetings, and company sales meetings as an active participant

* Determine customer needs and expectations for recommended product solutions.

* Respond timely, efficiently, thoughtfully, and thoroughly to inquiries related to training and in-depth product knowledge from both internal and external sources.

* Outbound and inbound account management as needed by assigned regional team.

* Other duties as assigned

  
  

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS AND ABILTIES**

* Preferred College Degree

* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards in a diverse workplace

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (ability to build excellent rapport with accounts)

* Positive and upbeat attitude

* Exceptional phone and customer service skills

* Able to perform multiple tasks efficiently

* Open to direction and a collaborative work style with commitment to get the job done

* Comfortable using technology and learning new programs and skills when needed

* Self-starter who can work independently

* Competent computer skills: MS Excel, MS Word, MS Outlook, Adobe and PowerPoint

* High Level of Flexibility in working with multiple time zones and with the direct boss remotely located.

* High Level of Flexibility to travel 30% of the time in pick moments.

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

* 3+ years’ experience inside sales experience or retail sales experience with proven track record

* Experience in the pharmaceutical, cosmetic or skincare industry

**Position is commensurate with experience.**

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**

This role requires regular travel and the ability to effectively perform work in a variety of professional environments, including customer sites, healthcare settings, conferences, and company locations. Responsibilities may involve extended periods of driving, standing, walking, and presenting, as well as transporting materials necessary to support customer interactions and business objectives. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

  

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

**Compensation**

The target base salary range for this role is $60,000-$65,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

**Benefits**

Revision Skincare® offers competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

**Next Steps**

If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.

The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager

The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team

  

Don't meet every single requirement? At Revision Skincare®, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

  

If you are considering employment at Revision Skincare®, review our job postings at revisionskincare.bamboohr.com/careers. Please be aware of fraudulent job offers and individuals falsely claiming to represent our Human Resources department. Our company will never request or offer payment, personal financial information, or sensitive data (such as Social Security numbers or bank details) during the early stages of recruitment. All legitimate communications from our HR team will come from official company email domains and follow our established hiring process.

  

Revision Skincare® is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Revision Skincare® is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment.

**Team Lead, Patient Scheduling & Conversions**

**AudioNova – A Sonova Brand**

Location: Remote
  
Department: Patient Revenue Operations & Conversions
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Base Salary: $62,000–$72,000 annually + performance-based incentive opportunity

**About AudioNova**
===================

At AudioNova, we are passionate about helping people experience the delight of hearing without limitations. We connect patients with hearing healthcare through exceptional service, innovative solutions, and a patient-first approach.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Team Lead, Patient Scheduling & Conversions leads, coaches, and develops a team of Patient Scheduling & Conversion Specialists supporting inbound and outbound patient engagement. This role helps ensure patients receive exceptional service while the team achieves appointment scheduling, conversion, quality, productivity, attendance, and patient experience goals.

The Team Lead uses CRM and contact center systems, quality results, and performance reporting to monitor performance and identify opportunities for improvement. This leader serves as a frontline resource for escalations, operational questions, process changes, and employee development, partnering with Operations, Workforce Management, Quality Assurance, Training, Analytics, Marketing, clinic teams, and other cross-functional partners.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Patient Scheduling & Conversion Specialists.
* Provide daily direction, support, and performance feedback; conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions, performance discussions, and team meetings.
* Monitor individual and team performance against scheduling, conversion, show-up, quality, productivity, and patient experience goals.
* Use performance reports, call observations, and quality results to identify coaching opportunities and improve results.
* Develop and monitor performance improvement plans and employee development plans.
* Reinforce approved call flows, scripts, scheduling processes, patient engagement standards, and accurate CRM documentation.
* Monitor attendance, schedule adherence, productivity, service levels, and real-time operational needs.
* Resolve escalated patient concerns and guide complex patient interactions with professionalism and compassion.
* Partner with Quality Assurance and Training to address performance gaps and support onboarding and ongoing employee development.
* Communicate business updates, process changes, priorities, and performance expectations.
* Collaborate with clinic teams, hearing care professionals, and cross-functional departments.
* Support patient engagement initiatives, process improvement, and contact center transformation efforts, including SMS, chat, and digital channels.
* Assist with interviewing, selecting, and onboarding new team members, and support patient interactions when operationally necessary.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Minimum 3 years of experience in a Team Lead, Supervisor, or contact center leadership position.
* Minimum 5 years of customer service, sales, appointment setting, patient scheduling, or contact center experience.
* Experience leading teams in retail healthcare, patient access, medical scheduling, hearing care, dental, vision, wellness, or a similar appointment-based environment.
* Demonstrated success coaching employees to achieve scheduling, conversion, productivity, patient experience, and quality goals.
* Experience managing KPIs, coaching plans, performance improvement plans, and employee development.
* Strong leadership, communication, conflict resolution, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data and develop action plans that improve individual and team results.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing business needs.
* Dedicated, quiet work-from-home environment and reliable high-speed internet connection.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience using CRM, quality, workforce management, scheduling, and contact center systems.
* Experience leading remote employees or distributed teams.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.

**Education**
=============

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, communications, leadership, or a related field preferred.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================

Success in this role may be measured by team schedule rate, appointments scheduled, show-up rate, conversion rate, completed evaluations, customer satisfaction, first contact resolution, escalation resolution, quality assurance scores, documentation accuracy, compliance, coaching completion, attendance, schedule adherence, productivity, service level support, employee retention, and engagement.

**Compensation & Benefits**
===========================

Base salary: $62,000–$72,000 annually, with an opportunity to earn additional compensation through a performance-based incentive program tied to team scheduling results, quality, attendance, patient experience, and operational performance.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Free hearing aids for employees and discounts for qualified family members.
* Career development, leadership training, and performance recognition opportunities.
* Remote work environment.

aed357542ff5bb72ab80.title: Account Executive, Expansion
aed357542ff5bb72ab80.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

As an Account Executive on our customer expansion team, you'll help existing Steer customers get more value from our platform. This is a **full-cycle sales role**: you'll identify opportunities in your book of customers, make outbound calls, learn how each shop operates, demonstrate the right solution, handle objections, and close upgrades to Steer CRM or our phones product.

You'll work with repair shop owners and managers who already know Steer, but you'll need to earn each conversation and make a clear case for why an additional product fits their business. We're looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, takes ownership of their pipeline, and can build trust with small business owners.

  

*The role is remote.*  
*Compensation: $60,000 base salary; $120,000 on-target earnings (OTE), including commission.*

  

**What You'll Do**

* Proactively call and follow up with existing Steer customers to uncover opportunities for CRM and phones upgrades.
* Manage the entire sales cycle, from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
* Learn each shop's goals and current workflow, then explain how the right Steer product could help.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent outreach and thoughtful follow-up.
* Keep customer conversations, opportunities, and forecasts accurate in the CRM.
* Partner with customer-facing teams to understand account history and support a smooth transition after the sale.
* Meet or exceed revenue and activity goals while providing a good experience for customers.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience owning and closing sales opportunities, ideally in a full-cycle or expansion sales role.
* Confidence making outbound calls and creating opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.
* Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
* The ability to explain software in practical terms to busy small business owners.
* Organized pipeline management and consistent follow-through.
* A coachable, self-directed approach and comfort working toward a quota.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience selling SaaS, CRM, communications, or phone products.
* Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base.
* Familiarity with automotive repair shops or other service businesses.

**Interview Process**

* Initial screen — 30 minutes with Lead Recruiter

* Executive Interview — 30 minutes with Head of Sales

* Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes with Sr. Sales Manager

* Problem Solving Interview - 60 minutes with Director of People

* Reference checks

**Benefits**

* 100% remote
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance
* Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum
* Generous parental leave
* FSA and HSA
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401(k)
* Learning stipend
* Work-from-home equipment
* Opportunities for career growth and development

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

bbd7cffe2b3e88a7ea7a.title: Manager, Financial Operations
bbd7cffe2b3e88a7ea7a.description:
**About OnPay**

**OnPay is a fast-growing software company headquartered in Atlanta, offering a modern cloud-based payroll, HR, and benefits solution for small to midsize businesses. We’re currently seeking talented and curious individuals to join our team. We want to hear from you if you are interested in joining an exciting and fast-growing company!**

**Learn more at** **OnPay.com**

**We’re on a mission to combine excellent client service with payroll expertise and superb technology — and we are scaling fast as we’ve just raised $100 million in growth funding led by Carrick Capital Partners.**

**The Role**

We are looking for a high-judgment, process-driven **Financial Operations Manager** to lead our Money Movement and Payroll Settlement team. In this role, you will own the engine of our business: ensuring funds are debited from client accounts accurately and delivered into the bank accounts of thousands of workers seamlessly and on time.

You will manage a daily operational team, oversee multi-million-dollar banking and ACH transmission workflows, lead exception handling (returns, reversals, NSF, and disputes), and partner directly with Risk Operations and banking partners to scale our treasury and clearing infrastructure.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, mentor, and scale a team of Financial Operations Specialists responsible for day-to-day payroll funding, direct deposit transmission, and exception processing.
* Oversee end-to-end clearing timelines across multiple banking rails (Same-Day ACH, Standard ACH, Wire, RTP, and FedNow).
* Ensure critical cut-off deadlines (Federal Reserve / ODFI / RDFI windows) are met with zero tolerance for delayed worker payroll disbursements.
* Monitor real-time account balances, debit settlements, credit batches, and intraday clearing files (NACHA, ISO 20022, proprietary bank APIs).
* Own the operational resolution of ACH returns (e.g., R01 NSF, R08 stop payment, R03 unauthorized account), credit reversals, trace requests, and payroll adjustments.
* Implement proactive fraud, exposure, and NSF-monitoring protocols to mitigate credit risk between debit settlement and credit disbursement.
* Serve as the senior point of escalation for high-value funding failures, off-cycle emergency payroll runs, and banking transmission disruptions.
* Maintain daily three-way reconciliation across client payroll records, internal ledger balances, and bank statements.
* Partner with Corporate Accounting and Treasury to track settlement float, collateral accounts, and clearing reserves.
* Design and enforce strict operational controls (Maker-Checker protocols, dual authorization, and change-log auditing) in compliance with SOX, SOC 1/SOC 2, and NACHA rules.
* Partner closely with Product and Core Platform Engineering to translate manual financial workflows into automated software tools.
* Drive root-cause analyses on recurring transaction failures, latency issues, or bank API errors to continuously improve straight-through processing (STP) rates.
* Maintain relationships with tier-1 partner banks and payment processors to optimize cut-off windows, fee structures, and clearing speeds.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in financial operations, treasury operations, payment operations, or payroll operations, with at least 2+ years managing high-performing operational teams.
* Deep familiarity with domestic money movement networks—specifically NACHA rules, ACH clearing cycles, return codes/reasoning, wire networks, and modern real-time rails.
* Prior experience at a payroll service provider, payroll software/PEO, merchant processor, or B2B embedded fintech platform.
* Demonstrated track record of managing high-volume, time-sensitive operational queues with strict SLAs.
* Strong technical understanding of ledger accounting, bank statement reconciliation, and settlement timing differences.
* Professional certifications such as Accredited ACH Professional (AAP), Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC).
* Experience working directly with bank APIs, SFTP batching, or modern ledgering engines.
* Working proficiency building operational dashboards and investigating transaction anomalies.
* Capable of making decisive, level-headed decisions during high-stakes banking outages or settlement delays.
* A coach who sets clear operational metrics (SLAs, error rates, resolution times) while fostering growth and accountability in team members.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or equivalent experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving capabilities, and clear written/verbal communication skills.
* Team-oriented, resilient, proactive and solutions-focused.
* Customer-service mindset: clear communication, patience, and professionalism when working with stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritize effectively.
* Must be highly organized, dependable and self-disciplined with a strong work ethic.
* Solid analytical skills, ability to learn at a fast pace.

**Why OnPay?**

* Momentum that matters: We’re backed by over $100MM in new funding and scaling rapidly.
* Market-leading product: OnPay consistently ranks among the highest-rated payroll solutions, earning top marks for usability, customer satisfaction, and support.
* Remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S., or join our collaborative HQ team in Atlanta’s Ponce City Market if you reside in the Atlanta metro area.
* Competitive compensation: Base salary + bonus + stock options = real upside for high performers.
* Comprehensive benefits: 4 weeks PTO + paid holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision, Short- & Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Fertility Benefits, Parental Leave, and a 401(k) with company match.
* Growth culture: Join a team with deep employee benefits experience, payroll expertise, market momentum, and a genuine commitment to helping employees grow their careers.
* Client-first ethos: OnPay is built on a culture of transparency and service — from our transparent pricing to our commitment to making small business simpler.

**Location & Compensation**

* Remote (U.S.) | Atlanta HQ Optional
* Compensation includes a base salary range of **$90,000 to $100,000****.** Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

**Recruiting Fraud Alert:**

**To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At OnPay, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at** **careers.onpay.com**

**Recruiters will never request payments or ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from OnPay, please email** **careers@onpay.com**

OnPay is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We want candidates from multiple backgrounds and lifestyles to create a broader set of perspectives. We make all employment decisions without regard to gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, color, religion, age, pregnancy, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable laws.
